## `./venice/lyrics.go`

```go
// lyrics.go — normalization of song-lyric text before it's sent to the Venice
// music API. The repo's song .md files (Tala/Ordo style) embed stage-direction
// and voice-tag headers like:
//
//	[Chorus - **Samael's voice, both registers simultaneously, inhuman**]
//
// Per the official MiniMax documentation, the lyrics input must contain ONLY the
// words to be sung plus clean structural tags; tags are "structural instructions
// rather than lines to be sung", and "lyrics define the words to be sung". Any
// descriptive text placed on a tag line (after the "]") gets treated as lyric
// content and sung/spoken by the model. So this normalizer:
//
//   - converts "[Chorus - **description**]" to a clean "[Chorus]" tag
//
//   - strips ALL descriptions from the lyrics (they belong in the prompt field)
//
//   - keeps only the sung words
//
//     [Chorus - **Samael's voice, both registers simultaneously, inhuman**]
//     ->  [Chorus]
package venice

import (
	"regexp"
	"strings"
)

// supportedTags are the section tags MiniMax Music v2.6 understands.
var supportedTags = map[string]bool{
	"intro": true, "verse": true, "pre-chorus": true, "chorus": true,
	"bridge": true, "outro": true, "hook": true, "solo": true,
	"break": true, "interlude": true, "instrumental": true, "drop": true,
	"build": true, "post-chorus": true,
}

// sectionHeaderRe matches a bracketed section header, optionally with a
// "- description" tail, e.g.:
//
//	[Chorus]                              -> group1="Chorus",     group2=""
//	[Chorus - Samael's voice...]          -> group1="Chorus",     group2=" - Samael's voice..."
//	[Verse 1 - **Male voice...**]         -> group1="Verse 1",    group2=" - **Male voice...**"
var sectionHeaderRe = regexp.MustCompile(`^\s*\[\s*([^\]\-]+?)\s*(\s*-\s*[^\]]*)?\]\s*$`)

// normalizeLyrics turns raw song-file text into clean, model-ready lyrics.
// It is safe to call with already-clean lyrics (returns them essentially as-is).
func normalizeLyrics(raw string) string {
	if raw == "" {
		return ""
	}

	lines := strings.Split(raw, "\n")
	var out []string

	for _, line := range lines {
		trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(line)

		// Drop horizontal-rule separators and empty runs between sections.
		if trimmed == "" || trimmed == "---" || trimmed == "***" || trimmed == "___" {
			continue
		}

		// Drop explicit end marker.
		if strings.EqualFold(trimmed, "[End]") || strings.EqualFold(trimmed, "[END]") {
			continue
		}

		// Drop markdown headings (# 09 - Samael, ## Lyrics) — not lyric text.
		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "#") {
			continue
		}

		// Section header: emit ONLY the clean tag ("[Verse]"). Descriptions after
		// the tag are dropped from the lyrics — MiniMax sings them otherwise.
		if m := sectionHeaderRe.FindStringSubmatch(trimmed); m != nil {
			tagWord := normalizeTagWord(m[1])
			if tagWord != "" {
				// Blank line separates the tag from the following lyrics block.
				out = append(out, "", "["+titleCaseTag(tagWord)+"]", "")
			}
			continue
		}

		// Ordinary lyric line: strip markdown emphasis markers but keep the text.
		clean := stripMarkdown(trimmed)
		if clean != "" {
			out = append(out, clean)
		}
	}

	// Join with newlines, then normalize spacing: keep a single blank line between
	// a section tag and its lyrics, but collapse any accidental double blanks and
	// trim leading/trailing blank lines.
	joined := strings.Join(out, "\n")
	joined = collapseBlankLines(joined)
	return strings.Trim(joined, "\n")
}

// collapseBlankLines reduces runs of two or more consecutive blank lines down to
// a single blank line, so tags and lyric blocks stay cleanly separated.
func collapseBlankLines(s string) string {
	lines := strings.Split(s, "\n")
	var out []string
	for i := 0; i < len(lines); i++ {
		out = append(out, lines[i])
		if strings.TrimSpace(lines[i]) == "" {
			// Skip any following blank lines.
			for i+1 < len(lines) && strings.TrimSpace(lines[i+1]) == "" {
				i++
			}
		}
	}
	return strings.Join(out, "\n")
}

// normalizeTagWord maps a raw header word ("Chorus", "Verse 1", "Pre Chorus") to
// a canonical supported tag ("chorus", "verse", "pre-chorus"). Returns "" if the
// word isn't a recognized section (e.g. it was purely a description).
func normalizeTagWord(raw string) string {
	w := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(raw))
	// Strip trailing section numbers ("verse 1" -> "verse", "chorus 2" -> "chorus").
	w = strings.TrimRight(w, "0123456789 ")
	w = strings.TrimSpace(w)
	// Normalize spacing/hyphens for multi-word tags.
	replace := strings.NewReplacer("-", " ", "_", " ", "  ", " ")
	w = replace.Replace(w)
	w = strings.Join(strings.Fields(w), "-")

	// Accept "prechorus" / "postchorus" forms too.
	switch w {
	case "prechorus":
		w = "pre-chorus"
	case "postchorus":
		w = "post-chorus"
	}

	if supportedTags[w] {
		return w
	}
	return ""
}

// titleCaseTag capitalizes the first letter of each hyphen-separated word of a
// canonical tag so the output reads [Intro], [Pre-Chorus], [Outro] (the form the
// MiniMax models are documented with).
func titleCaseTag(tag string) string {
	parts := strings.Split(tag, "-")
	for i, p := range parts {
		if p == "" {
			continue
		}
		parts[i] = strings.ToUpper(p[:1]) + p[1:]
	}
	return strings.Join(parts, "-")
}

// stripMarkdown removes markdown emphasis ( * _ ` ) from a lyric line, keeping
// the words. Bold `**...**` and italic `*...*` both reduce to plain text.
var markdownRe = regexp.MustCompile(`[\\*_` + "`" + `]`)

func stripMarkdown(line string) string {
	s := markdownRe.ReplaceAllString(line, "")
	return strings.TrimSpace(s)
}
```

```go
package venice

import (
	"bytes"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"log"
	"mime/multipart"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"time"
)

// veniceClient is a minimal HTTP client for the Venice API (base /api/v1).
type veniceClient struct {
	BaseURL string
	APIKey  string
	HTTP    *http.Client
}

func newVeniceClient(cfg *Config) *veniceClient {
	return &veniceClient{
		BaseURL: strings.TrimSuffix(cfg.VeniceBaseURL, "/"),
		APIKey:  cfg.VeniceAPIKey,
		HTTP:    &http.Client{Timeout: 180 * time.Second},
	}
}

func (v *veniceClient) authHeader() string { return "Bearer " + v.APIKey }

// doJSON sends a JSON request and decodes the response into out.
func (v *veniceClient) doJSON(method, path string, body any, out any) error {
	var reader io.Reader
	if body != nil {
		b, err := json.Marshal(body)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		reader = bytes.NewReader(b)
	}
	req, err := http.NewRequest(method, v.BaseURL+path, reader)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	req.Header.Set("Authorization", v.authHeader())
	req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := v.HTTP.Do(req)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	bodyBytes, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if resp.StatusCode < 200 || resp.StatusCode >= 300 {
		return fmt.Errorf("Venice API %s %s -> HTTP %d: %s", method, path, resp.StatusCode, truncate(string(bodyBytes), 500))
	}
	if out != nil && len(bodyBytes) > 0 {
		return json.Unmarshal(bodyBytes, out)
	}
	return nil
}

func truncate(s string, n int) string {
	if len(s) <= n {
		return s
	}
	return s[:n] + "..."
}

// --- Chat ---

type chatMessage struct {
	Role    string `json:"role"`
	Content string `json:"content"`
}

type chatRequest struct {
	Model            string         `json:"model"`
	Messages         []chatMessage  `json:"messages"`
	VeniceParameters map[string]any `json:"venice_parameters,omitempty"`
}

type chatChoice struct {
	Message struct {
		Content string `json:"content"`
	} `json:"message"`
}

type chatResponse struct {
	Choices []chatChoice `json:"choices"`
}

// Chat sends a chat completion; returns the assistant text.
func (v *veniceClient) Chat(model, system, user string, web bool) (string, error) {
	messages := []chatMessage{}
	if system != "" {
		messages = append(messages, chatMessage{Role: "system", Content: system})
	}
	messages = append(messages, chatMessage{Role: "user", Content: user})
	req := chatRequest{Model: model, Messages: messages}
	if web {
		req.VeniceParameters = map[string]any{"enable_web_search": "on"}
	}
	var resp chatResponse
	if err := v.doJSON("POST", "/chat/completions", req, &resp); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if len(resp.Choices) == 0 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("no choices in chat response")
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(resp.Choices[0].Message.Content), nil
}

// --- Image ---

type imageRequest struct {
	Model  string `json:"model"`
	Prompt string `json:"prompt"`
	Size   string `json:"size,omitempty"`
}

type imageResponse struct {
	ID     string   `json:"id"`
	Images []string `json:"images"`
}

// GenerateImage returns the decoded image bytes + detected extension.
func (v *veniceClient) GenerateImage(model, prompt, size string) ([]byte, string, error) {
	req := imageRequest{Model: model, Prompt: prompt, Size: size}
	var resp imageResponse
	if err := v.doJSON("POST", "/image/generate", req, &resp); err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	if len(resp.Images) == 0 {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("no image in response")
	}
	b64 := resp.Images[0]
	// Strip possible data URL prefix.
	if i := strings.Index(b64, "base64,"); i >= 0 {
		b64 = b64[i+7:]
	}
	raw, err := base64.StdEncoding.DecodeString(b64)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("decoding image: %w", err)
	}
	return raw, detectImageExt(raw), nil
}

func detectImageExt(b []byte) string {
	if len(b) >= 4 {
		switch {
		case b[0] == 0x89 && b[1] == 'P' && b[2] == 'N' && b[3] == 'G':
			return "png"
		case b[0] == 0xFF && b[1] == 0xD8:
			return "jpg"
		case b[0] == 'R' && b[1] == 'I' && b[2] == 'F' && b[3] == 'F':
			return "webp"
		}
	}
	return "png"
}

// --- TTS ---

type ttsRequest struct {
	Model          string `json:"model"`
	Input          string `json:"input"`
	Voice          string `json:"voice"`
	ResponseFormat string `json:"response_format"`
}

// TTS generates speech audio and returns the bytes + detected extension.
func (v *veniceClient) TTS(model, text, voice, format string) ([]byte, string, error) {
	req := ttsRequest{Model: model, Input: text, Voice: voice, ResponseFormat: format}
	payload, _ := json.Marshal(req)
	httpReq, err := http.NewRequest("POST", v.BaseURL+"/audio/speech", bytes.NewReader(payload))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	httpReq.Header.Set("Authorization", v.authHeader())
	httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	resp, err := v.HTTP.Do(httpReq)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	b, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 50<<20))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, "", err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != 200 {
		return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("TTS HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, truncate(string(b), 500))
	}
	ct := resp.Header.Get("Content-Type")
	ext := "mp3"
	switch {
	case strings.Contains(ct, "wav"):
		ext = "wav"
	case strings.Contains(ct, "flac"):
		ext = "flac"
	case strings.Contains(ct, "ogg"):
		ext = "ogg"
	}
	return b, ext, nil
}

// --- Voice Cloning ---

// clonedVoiceResponse is the response from POST /audio/voices.
type clonedVoiceResponse struct {
	ID    string `json:"id"`
	Model string `json:"model"`
}

// CloneVoice uploads an audio sample to clone a voice and returns the
// `vv_...` handle. model must be tts-chatterbox-hd (default) or
// tts-minimax-speech-02-hd. The handle is passed as `voice` to TTS with the
// same model.
func (v *veniceClient) CloneVoice(model string, sample []byte, filename string) (*clonedVoiceResponse, error) {
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	mw := multipart.NewWriter(&buf)

	// model field
	if err := mw.WriteField("model", model); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	// file field
	fw, err := mw.CreateFormFile("file", filename)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if _, err := fw.Write(sample); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := mw.Close(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	httpReq, err := http.NewRequest("POST", v.BaseURL+"/audio/voices", &buf)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	httpReq.Header.Set("Authorization", v.authHeader())
	httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", mw.FormDataContentType())

	resp, err := v.HTTP.Do(httpReq)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	b, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 1<<20))
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if resp.StatusCode != 200 {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("voice clone HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, truncate(string(b), 500))
	}
	var out clonedVoiceResponse
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &out); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("parsing clone response: %w", err)
	}
	if out.ID == "" {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("clone response missing id: %s", truncate(string(b), 200))
	}
	return &out, nil
}

// ttsFormatForModel returns the response_format supported by a TTS model.
// tts-chatterbox-hd and tts-minimax-speech-02-hd support only WAV; other TTS
// models (e.g. tts-kokoro) accept mp3.
func ttsFormatForModel(model string) string {
	switch model {
	case "tts-chatterbox-hd", "tts-minimax-speech-02-hd":
		return "wav"
	default:
		return "mp3"
	}
}

// --- STT ---

// Transcribe sends an audio file to /audio/transcriptions (multipart).
func (v *veniceClient) Transcribe(model, filePath, format string) (string, error) {
	f, err := os.Open(filePath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	var buf bytes.Buffer
	mw := multipart.NewWriter(&buf)
	mw.WriteField("model", model)
	mw.WriteField("response_format", format)
	fw, err := mw.CreateFormFile("file", filePath)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if _, err := io.Copy(fw, f); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	mw.Close()

	httpReq, err := http.NewRequest("POST", v.BaseURL+"/audio/transcriptions", &buf)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	httpReq.Header.Set("Authorization", v.authHeader())
	httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", mw.FormDataContentType())
	resp, err := v.HTTP.Do(httpReq)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer resp.Body.Close()
	b, _ := io.ReadAll(resp.Body)
	if resp.StatusCode != 200 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("STT HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, truncate(string(b), 500))
	}
	// If response_format is text, return raw; otherwise try to extract text.
	if format == "text" {
		return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
	}
	var parsed map[string]any
	if err := json.Unmarshal(b, &parsed); err == nil {
		if t, ok := parsed["text"].(string); ok {
			return strings.TrimSpace(t), nil
		}
	}
	return strings.TrimSpace(string(b)), nil
}

// --- Balance ---

type balanceResponse struct {
	Balances struct {
		USD  *float64 `json:"usd"`
		DIEM *float64 `json:"diem"`
	} `json:"balances"`
	CanConsume          bool   `json:"canConsume"`
	ConsumptionCurrency string `json:"consumptionCurrency"`
}

// Balance returns a formatted balance string.
func (v *veniceClient) Balance() (string, error) {
	var resp balanceResponse
	if err := v.doJSON("GET", "/billing/balance", nil, &resp); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	var sb strings.Builder
	if resp.Balances.USD != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "USD: $%.2f\n", *resp.Balances.USD)
	}
	if resp.Balances.DIEM != nil {
		fmt.Fprintf(&sb, "DIEM: %.4f\n", *resp.Balances.DIEM)
	}
	sb.WriteString("canConsume: ")
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("%v", resp.CanConsume))
	return strings.TrimSpace(sb.String()), nil
}

// --- Models ---

type modelInfo struct {
	ID        string `json:"id"`
	ModelSpec struct {
		Name        string `json:"name"`
		Description string `json:"description"`
	} `json:"model_spec"`
}

// Models returns model IDs for a modality (text|image|video|music|embedding|asr).
func (v *veniceClient) Models(modality string) ([]modelInfo, error) {
	path := "/models"
	if modality != "" {
		path += "?type=" + modality
	}
	var resp struct {
		Data []modelInfo `json:"data"`
	}
	if err := v.doJSON("GET", path, nil, &resp); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return resp.Data, nil
}

// --- Async audio (music/SFX) ---

type audioQueueRequest struct {
	Model        string `json:"model"`
	Prompt       string `json:"prompt"`
	Lyrics       string `json:"lyrics_prompt,omitempty"`
	DurationSec  *int   `json:"duration_seconds,omitempty"`
	Instrumental bool   `json:"force_instrumental,omitempty"`
}

type audioQueueResponse struct {
	Model   string `json:"model"`
	QueueID string `json:"queue_id"`
	Status  string `json:"status"`
}

type audioQuoteRequest struct {
	Model       string `json:"model"`
	DurationSec int    `json:"duration_seconds"`
}

type audioQuoteResponse struct {
	Quote float64 `json:"quote"`
}

// QuoteAudio asks Venice for the estimated cost of a music generation.
func (v *veniceClient) QuoteAudio(model string, duration int) (float64, error) {
	var resp audioQuoteResponse
	if err := v.doJSON("POST", "/audio/quote", audioQuoteRequest{
		Model: model, DurationSec: duration,
	}, &resp); err != nil {
		return 0, err
	}
	return resp.Quote, nil
}

// QueueAudio starts an async music/audio generation job; returns the queue_id.
func (v *veniceClient) QueueAudio(model, prompt, lyrics string, instrumental bool, duration int) (string, error) {
	req := audioQueueRequest{Model: model, Prompt: prompt, Lyrics: lyrics, Instrumental: instrumental}
	if duration > 0 {
		req.DurationSec = &duration
	}
	var resp audioQueueResponse
	if err := v.doJSON("POST", "/audio/queue", req, &resp); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	if resp.QueueID == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("no queue_id in audio/queue response")
	}
	return resp.QueueID, nil
}

type audioRetrieveRequest struct {
	Model                   string `json:"model"`
	QueueID                 string `json:"queue_id"`
	DeleteMediaOnCompletion bool   `json:"delete_media_on_completion,omitempty"`
}

// WaitAudio polls /audio/retrieve until the clip is ready (binary body), then
// calls /audio/complete to clean up. Returns audio bytes + extension.
func (v *veniceClient) WaitAudio(model, queueID string, pollSec, timeoutMin int) ([]byte, string, error) {
	deadline := time.Now().Add(time.Duration(timeoutMin) * time.Minute)
	for time.Now().Before(deadline) {
		req := audioRetrieveRequest{Model: model, QueueID: queueID, DeleteMediaOnCompletion: false}
		payload, _ := json.Marshal(req)
		httpReq, err := http.NewRequest("POST", v.BaseURL+"/audio/retrieve", bytes.NewReader(payload))
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		httpReq.Header.Set("Authorization", v.authHeader())
		httpReq.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		resp, err := v.HTTP.Do(httpReq)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		ct := resp.Header.Get("Content-Type")
		body, readErr := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(resp.Body, 60<<20))
		closeErr := resp.Body.Close()
		if readErr != nil {
			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("reading audio retrieve response: %w", readErr)
		}
		if closeErr != nil {
			log.Printf("audio retrieve response close failed: %v", closeErr)
		}
		if resp.StatusCode < http.StatusOK || resp.StatusCode >= http.StatusMultipleChoices {
			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("Venice audio retrieve returned HTTP %d: %s", resp.StatusCode, truncate(string(body), 500))
		}

		// Still processing → JSON status body.
		if strings.Contains(ct, "application/json") {
			var st struct {
				Status string `json:"status"`
			}
			json.Unmarshal(body, &st)
			log.Printf("audio poll: status=%s queue=%s", st.Status, queueID)
			time.Sleep(time.Duration(pollSec) * time.Second)
			continue
		}
		if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(ct), "audio/") {
			return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("unexpected audio retrieve content type %q: %s", ct, truncate(string(body), 500))
		}

		ext := "mp3"
		switch {
		case strings.Contains(ct, "wav"):
			ext = "wav"
		case strings.Contains(ct, "flac"):
			ext = "flac"
		case strings.Contains(ct, "ogg"):
			ext = "ogg"
		}
		// Clean up Venice's copy after receiving the audio.
		complete := audioRetrieveRequest{Model: model, QueueID: queueID}
		if err := v.doJSON("POST", "/audio/complete", complete, nil); err != nil {
			log.Printf("audio completion cleanup failed for queue %s: %v", queueID, err)
		}
		return body, ext, nil
	}
	return nil, "", fmt.Errorf("timed out waiting for audio generation")
}
```

## `./venice/handlers.go`

```go
package venice

import (
	"bytes"
	"fmt"
	"log"
	"strconv"
	"strings"

	"github.com/bwmarrin/discordgo"
)

// handleChat: /chat [prompt] [model] [web]
func handleChat(s *discordgo.Session, i *discordgo.InteractionCreate, get func(string) string) {
	prompt := get("prompt")
	if prompt == "" {
		respond(s, i, "Please provide a prompt.")
		return
	}
	model := get("model")
	if model == "" {
		model = cfg.DefaultChatModel
	}
	web := get("web") == "true"

	respondDefer(s, i)

	reply, err := vc.Chat(model, "", prompt, web)
	if err != nil {
		editResponse(s, i, "Error: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	if reply == "" {
		editResponse(s, i, "(empty reply)")
		return
	}
	editResponse(s, i, reply)
}

// handleImage: /image [prompt] [model] [size] → uploads the generated image.
func handleImage(s *discordgo.Session, i *discordgo.InteractionCreate, get func(string) string) {
	prompt := get("prompt")
	if prompt == "" {
		respond(s, i, "Please provide a prompt.")
		return
	}
	model := get("model")
	if model == "" {
		model = cfg.DefaultImageModel
	}
	size := get("size")

	respondDefer(s, i)

	data, ext, err := vc.GenerateImage(model, prompt, size)
	if err != nil {
		editResponse(s, i, "Error: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	// Quality guard: some models return a tiny ~8-10KB image (diffusion
	// steps:0) that comes out as a blur. Warn but still upload.
	if len(data) < 15000 {
		warn := fmt.Sprintf("⚠️ `%s` returned a very small image (%d bytes) — likely blurred (steps:0). Try `/image model:venice-sd35` for full quality. Uploading what came back:", model, len(data))
		if _, err := s.ChannelMessageSend(i.ChannelID, warn); err != nil {
			logErrorf("image guard message failed: %v", err)
		}
	}
	// Upload as attachment.
	file := &discordgo.File{
		Name:   fmt.Sprintf("venice_%s.%s", i.ID, ext),
		Reader: bytes.NewReader(data),
	}
	// Send as a follow-up message with the attachment.
	_, err = s.ChannelMessageSendComplex(i.ChannelID, &discordgo.MessageSend{
		Content: fmt.Sprintf("**%s** — generated with `%s`", truncateForDiscord(prompt), model),
		Files:   []*discordgo.File{file},
	})
	if err != nil {
		editResponse(s, i, "Error: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	editResponse(s, i, "Image generated ✅")
}

// handleTTS: /tts [text] [voice] → uploads speech audio.
func handleTTS(s *discordgo.Session, i *discordgo.InteractionCreate, get func(string) string) {
	text := get("text")
	if text == "" {
		respond(s, i, "Please provide text to speak.")
		return
	}
	voice := get("voice")
	model := cfg.DefaultTTSModel
	if voice == "" {
		voice = cfg.DefaultTTSVoice
	} else {
		// If the voice matches a stored cloned-voice name, use its vv_ handle
		// and its model (cloned handles are model-specific).
		if store, err := loadClonedVoiceStore(); err == nil {
			if id, m, ok := store.find(voice); ok {
				voice = id
				model = m
			}
		}
	}

	respondDefer(s, i)

	data, ext, err := vc.TTS(model, text, voice, ttsFormatForModel(model))
	if err != nil {
		editResponse(s, i, "Error: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	_, err = s.ChannelMessageSendComplex(i.ChannelID, &discordgo.MessageSend{
		Content: "**TTS** — `" + voice + "`",
		Files:   []*discordgo.File{{Name: fmt.Sprintf("venice_tts_%s.%s", i.ID, ext), Reader: bytes.NewReader(data)}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		editResponse(s, i, "Error: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	editResponse(s, i, "Speech generated ✅")
}

// handleVoiceClone: /voice-clone <name> [mp3] [model] — clone a voice from an
// attached audio sample using Venice's /audio/voices, then store the handle.
func handleVoiceClone(s *discordgo.Session, i *discordgo.InteractionCreate, get func(string) string) {
	name := strings.TrimSpace(get("name"))
	if name == "" {
		respond(s, i, "Usage: `/voice-clone name:<name> mp3:<file>` (attach an audio sample).")
		return
	}
	model := strings.TrimSpace(get("model"))
	if model == "" {
		model = "tts-chatterbox-hd"
	}

	attach := getAttachment(i, get("mp3"))
	if attach == nil {
		respond(s, i, "Please attach an audio sample via the **mp3** option (`/voice-clone name:<name> mp3:<file>`). MP3/WAV/FLAC/M4A work.")
		return
	}
	if attach.ContentType != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(attach.ContentType, "audio/") {
		respond(s, i, fmt.Sprintf("❌ Attached file `%s` is `%s`, not audio.", attach.Filename, attach.ContentType))
		return
	}

	respondDefer(s, i)

	// Download the attachment bytes (Discord CDN).
	sample, err := downloadURL(attach.URL)
	if err != nil {
		editResponse(s, i, "❌ Could not download the attached audio: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	out, err := vc.CloneVoice(model, sample, attach.Filename)
	if err != nil {
		editResponse(s, i, "❌ Voice cloning failed: "+err.Error())
		return
	}

	// Store the handle locally.
	store, err := loadClonedVoiceStore()
	if err != nil {
		log.Printf("[voice-clone] warning: could not load store: %v", err)
	} else if err := store.add(out.ID, out.Model, name); err != nil {
		log.Printf("[voice-clone] warning: could not save handle: %v", err)
	}

	editResponse(s, i, fmt.Sprintf("🎙️ **Voice cloned** — **%s**\n- Handle: `%s`\n- Model: `%s`\n\nUse it with `/tts text:... voice:%s`.\n_Handles expire after 7 days._", name, out.ID, out.Model, name))
}

// handleVoices: /voices — list locally stored cloned voice handles.
func handleVoices(s *discordgo.Session, i *discordgo.InteractionCreate, get func(string) string) {
	store, err := loadClonedVoiceStore()
	if err != nil {
		respond(s, i, "⚠️ Could not read cloned voices: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	respond(s, i, store.format())
}

const (
	minMusicDurationSeconds     = 120
	defaultMusicDurationSeconds = 240
	maxMusicDurationSeconds     = 360
)

// musicQueueMessage includes the requested duration and Venice's price estimate.
func musicQueueMessage(model string, durationSeconds int, quote float64) string {
	msg := fmt.Sprintf("Queued music job (`%s`). Generating... this can take a minute or two. I'll post the result when ready.", model)
	msg += fmt.Sprintf("\n\nRequested duration: **%s** · Venice estimate: **$%.4f**", formatDuration(durationSeconds), quote)
	return msg
}

// formatDuration renders seconds as "1m 45s" for ≥60s or "45s" otherwise.
func formatDuration(sec int) string {
	if sec < 60 {
		return fmt.Sprintf("%ds", sec)
	}
	m := sec / 60
	s := sec % 60
	if s == 0 {
		return fmt.Sprintf("%dm", m)
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%dm %ds", m, s)
}

// handleMusic: /music [prompt] [lyrics] → async music generation.
func handleMusic(s *discordgo.Session, i *discordgo.InteractionCreate, get func(string) string) {
	prompt := get("prompt")
	if prompt == "" {
		respond(s, i, "Please provide a music prompt.")
		return
	}
	durationSeconds := defaultMusicDurationSeconds
	if rawDuration := get("duration"); rawDuration != "" {
		parsedDuration, err := strconv.Atoi(rawDuration)
		if err != nil || parsedDuration < minMusicDurationSeconds || parsedDuration > maxMusicDurationSeconds {
			respond(s, i, fmt.Sprintf(
				"Duration must be between %d and %d seconds.",
				minMusicDurationSeconds,
				maxMusicDurationSeconds,
			))
			return
		}
		durationSeconds = parsedDuration
	}
	lyrics := get("lyrics")

	// Normalize song-file style lyrics (Tala/Ordo [Section - Voice] headers,
	// markdown, --- separators) into clean MiniMax Music v2.6 structure tags so
	// the model doesn't sing the stage directions.
	if lyrics != "" {
		lyrics = normalizeLyrics(lyrics)
		// Log the exact lyrics about to be sent to the API for review.
		if path, err := logNormalizedLyrics(prompt, lyrics); err == nil {
			fmt.Printf("[music] normalized lyrics logged to %s\n", path)
		} else {
			fmt.Printf("[music] warning: could not log normalized lyrics: %v\n", err)
		}
	}

	respondDefer(s, i)

	model := cfg.DefaultMusicModel
	quote, err := vc.QuoteAudio(model, durationSeconds)
	if err != nil {
		editResponse(s, i, "Could not estimate music cost: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	queueID, err := vc.QueueAudio(model, prompt, lyrics, false, durationSeconds)
	if err != nil {
		editResponse(s, i, "Error: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	editResponse(s, i, musicQueueMessage(model, durationSeconds, quote))

	// Poll in a goroutine and post when done.
	go func() {
		data, ext, err := vc.WaitAudio(model, queueID, 15, 10)
		if err != nil {
			editResponse(s, i, "Music generation failed: "+err.Error())
			return
		}
		_, err = s.ChannelMessageSendComplex(i.ChannelID, &discordgo.MessageSend{
			Content: "**Music** — `" + model + "`",
			Files:   []*discordgo.File{{Name: fmt.Sprintf("venice_music_%s.%s", i.ID, ext), Reader: bytes.NewReader(data)}},
		})
		if err != nil {
			editResponse(s, i, "Error posting music: "+err.Error())
		}
	}()
}

// handleBalance: /balance
func handleBalance(s *discordgo.Session, i *discordgo.InteractionCreate) {
	bal, err := vc.Balance()
	if err != nil {
		respond(s, i, "Error: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	respond(s, i, "**Venice Balance**\n"+bal)
}

// handleModels: /models [type]
func handleModels(s *discordgo.Session, i *discordgo.InteractionCreate, get func(string) string) {
	modality := get("type")
	models, err := vc.Models(modality)
	if err != nil {
		respond(s, i, "Error: "+err.Error())
		return
	}
	var sb strings.Builder
	sb.WriteString(fmt.Sprintf("**Venice models** (`%s`):\n", modality))
	for _, m := range models {
		sb.WriteString("- ")
		sb.WriteString(m.ID)
		sb.WriteString("\n")
		if sb.Len() > 1500 {
			sb.WriteString("... and more")
			break
		}
	}
	respond(s, i, sb.String())
}
```

```go
package venice

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"
)

// GenerateEroticQuote creates one original adult erotic quote guided by examples.
func GenerateEroticQuote(examples []string) (string, error) {
	if vc == nil || cfg == nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("Venice is not initialized")
	}
	if len(examples) != 10 {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("exactly 10 example quotes are required; got %d", len(examples))
	}

	models, err := vc.Models("text")
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("checking available Venice text models: %w", err)
	}
	model, _, err := selectConfessionModel(models, cfg.DefaultChatModel)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}

	var prompt strings.Builder
	prompt.WriteString(`Write one original erotic quote, using these examples only to understand the desired tone, style, and level of intimacy. Do not copy or closely paraphrase them. The quote must involve consenting adults. Return only the new quote, with no heading or explanation, and keep it under 1,800 characters.

Examples:
`)
	for index, example := range examples {
		fmt.Fprintf(&prompt, "%d. %s\n", index+1, example)
	}

	quote, err := vc.Chat(
		model,
		"You write original, intimate erotic quotes about consenting adults in the style requested by the user.",
		prompt.String(),
		false,
	)
	if err != nil {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("generating with Venice model %q: %w", model, err)
	}
	quote = strings.TrimSpace(quote)
	if quote == "" {
		return "", fmt.Errorf("Venice returned an empty quote")
	}
	return quote, nil
}
```

```go
// commands.go — Venice subpackage command definitions for the ElyLightspeed bot.
// All commands are registered with the "venice-" prefix (e.g. /venice-chat).
package venice

import (

	"github.com/bwmarrin/discordgo"

// CommandSpec pairs a command definition with its handler, mirroring the
// main package's commandSpec so the main package can register these directly.
type CommandSpec struct {
	Command *discordgo.ApplicationCommand
	Handler func(s *discordgo.Session, i *discordgo.InteractionCreate)
}

// handleVeniceCommand routes the root /venice command to the correct subcommand handler.
func handleVeniceCommand(s *discordgo.Session, i *discordgo.InteractionCreate) {
	data := i.ApplicationCommandData()
	if len(data.Options) == 0 {
		return
	}
	subCommand := data.Options[0]

	// Create a dynamic 'get' function that reads options from the subcommand, not the root command
	get := func(key string) string {
		for _, o := range subCommand.Options {
			if o.Name == key {
				if s, ok := o.Value.(string); ok {
					return s
				}
				return fmt.Sprintf("%v", o.Value)
			}
		}
		return ""
	}

	switch subCommand.Name {
	case "chat":
		handleChat(s, i, get)
	case "image":
		handleImage(s, i, get)
	case "tts":
		handleTTS(s, i, get)
	case "voice-clone":
		handleVoiceClone(s, i, get)
	case "voices":
		handleVoices(s, i, get)
	case "balance":
		handleBalance(s, i) // balance doesn't use 'get'
	case "models":
		handleModels(s, i, get)
	case "music":
		handleMusic(s, i, get)
	case "stt":
		handleSTT(s, i, get)
	case "search":
		handleSearch(s, i, get)
	case "scrape":
		handleScrape(s, i, get)
	case "video":
		handleVideo(s, i, get)
	case "embed":
		handleEmbed(s, i, get)
	case "characters":
		handleCharacters(s, i, get)
	case "upscale":
		handleUpscale(s, i, get)
	}
}
```

## `./Overkill/bot/ai.js`

```javascript
// bot/ai.js — AI calls for the Overkill Discord bot, using only global fetch.
//   nvidiaChat()  — OpenAI-style chat completions against integrate.api.nvidia.com
//                   (reuses the personality.* / captioning.* block — the same vision
//                   model the Python tools use for text, verified working on the key).
//   cohereRerank()— optional second-stage re-ranker; returns null (never throws) when
//                   the key is absent or the call fails, so /ask still works on the
//                   local lexical ranking alone.

import { loadConfig } from './config.js';

const { nvidia, cohere } = loadConfig();

export function nvidiaConfigured() {
  return Boolean(nvidia?.apiKey && nvidia?.model && nvidia?.base_url);
}

export async function nvidiaChat(system, user, { maxTokens = 900, temperature = 0.4 } = {}) {
  const base = String(nvidia.base_url).replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const body = {
    model: nvidia.model,
    max_tokens: maxTokens,
    temperature,
    messages: [
      { role: 'system', content: system },
      { role: 'user', content: user },
    ],
  };
  const res = await fetch(`${base}/chat/completions`, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${nvidia.apiKey}` },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(240_000),
  });
  if (!res.ok) {
    let detail = '';
    try { detail = (await res.text()).slice(0, 300); } catch { /* ignore */ }
    throw new Error(`NVIDIA HTTP ${res.status}: ${detail}`);
  }
  const data = await res.json();
  return String(data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content ?? '').trim();
}

export async function cohereRerank(query, documents, { topN = 5, model = 'rerank-v4.0-fast' } = {}) {
  if (!cohere?.apiKey || !documents.length) return null;
  try {
    const res = await fetch('https://api.cohere.com/v2/rerank', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', Authorization: `Bearer ${cohere.apiKey}` },
      body: JSON.stringify({ model, query, documents, top_n: topN }),
      signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60_000),
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const detail = (await res.text()).slice(0, 300);
      console.warn(`[ai] cohere rerank skipped (HTTP ${res.status}): ${detail}`);
      return null;
    }
    const data = await res.json();
    const results = data.results ?? data.data ?? [];
    return results.map((r) => ({ index: Number(r.index), score: Number(r.relevance_score ?? 0) }));
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn(`[ai] cohere rerank skipped (${err?.message ?? err})`);
    return null;
  }
}
```

## `./Overkill/bot/rag.js`

```javascript
// bot/rag.js — retrieval over the Overkill archive for the Discord bot.
//
// Corpus: every piece key in captions/captions.json ("jpg/X.jpg", "pdf/Y.pdf")
// enriched with captions/synopses.json (the Mistral-OCR read-throughs of the PDFs),
// plus the Notes column parsed from catalog/index.md.
//
// Retrieval: zero-dependency lexical index (stopwords + term scoring with field
// boosts for title/tags) so /search and /piece work instantly and offline. /ask
// optionally refines the top of the list with a Cohere rerank call (ai.js) and
// sends the winner documents to NVIDIA for a cited answer.
//
// GitHub blob links point at the private repo (github.com/daniel-kill/Overkill) —
// family-only, matching the archive's privacy rule.

import { readFileSync, existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { REPO_ROOT } from './config.js';

const CAPTIONS_FILE = path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'captions', 'captions.json');
const SYNOPSES_FILE = path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'captions', 'synopses.json');
const CATALOG_FILE = path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'catalog', 'index.md');
const GITHUB_BASE = 'https://github.com/daniel-kill/Overkill/blob/main/';

const STOP = new Set(('a an the and or but of in on at to for with is are was were it its this '
  + 'that he she they his her their as by from be been being have has had do does did not no so '
  + 'too very just about into over all any some then than there here when where which who what '
  + 'you your we our i me my').split(' '));

export function tokenize(text) {
  return String(text ?? '')
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, ' ')
    .split(/\s+/)
    .filter((w) => w.length > 1 && !STOP.has(w));
}

export function anchorFor(key) {
  // Mirror of tools/_common.py anchor_for_key: slug of the bare filename, no extension.
  return path.basename(key).replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '').toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
}

export function ghUrl(filePath) {
  const enc = filePath.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/');
  return `${GITHUB_BASE}${enc}`;
}

function readJson(file) {
  try { return JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8')); } catch { return {}; }
}

/** Build the piece list: {key, title, mood, tags[], description, synopsis, note, url, anchor}. */
export function buildCorpus() {
  const captions = readJson(CAPTIONS_FILE);
  const synopses = readJson(SYNOPSES_FILE);
  const docs = [];

  for (const key of Object.keys(captions).sort()) {
    const c = captions[key] ?? {};
    const s = synopses[key] ?? {};
    const title = c.title || path.basename(key).replace(/\.[^.]+$/, '');
    docs.push({
      key,
      title,
      mood: c.mood || '',
      tags: Array.isArray(c.tags) ? c.tags : [],
      description: String(c.description || '').trim(),
      synopsis: String(s.synopsis || '').trim(),
      anchor: anchorFor(key),
      url: ghUrl(`originals/${key}`),
      captionUrl: `${ghUrl('captions/README.md')}#${anchorFor(key)}`,
    });
  }

  // Notes column from the catalog (human-kept facts, useful context for /ask).
  let catalogNotes = {};
  try {
    const text = readFileSync(CATALOG_FILE, 'utf8');
    for (const line of text.split('\n')) {
      if (!line.startsWith('|')) continue;
      const cells = line.split('|').map((s) => s.trim());
      if (cells.length < 7) continue;
      const name = (cells[3] ?? '').replace(/^\[(.+?)\]\(<.+>\)$/, '$1');
      if (name) catalogNotes[`pdf/${name}`] = cells[6] ?? '';
    }
  } catch { /* no catalog yet */ }
  for (const doc of docs) {
    doc.note = String(catalogNotes[doc.key] || '').trim();
  }
  return docs;
}
/** Lexical index over the corpus. Field boosts: title 3, tags 2, mood/note 1.5, rest 1. */
export function buildIndex(docs) {
  const postings = new Map();   // term -> Map(docIdx -> weight)
  const docNorm = new Float64Array(docs.length);
  docs.forEach((doc, idx) => {
    const fields = [
      [doc.title, 3], [doc.tags.join(' '), 2], [doc.mood, 1.5], [doc.note, 1.5],
      [doc.description, 1], [doc.synopsis, 1], [doc.key, 1.2],
    ];
    const w = new Map();
    for (const [text, boost] of fields) {
      for (const t of tokenize(text)) {
        w.set(t, (w.get(t) ?? 0) + boost);
      }
    }
    docNorm[idx] = Math.sqrt([...w.values()].reduce((a, b) => a + b * b, 0)) || 1;
    for (const [t, weight] of w) {
      if (!postings.has(t)) postings.set(t, new Map());
      postings.get(t).set(idx, (postings.get(t).get(idx) ?? 0) + weight);
    }
  });
  return { postings, docNorm };
}

/** Score one query against the index; returns [{index, score}...] sorted desc. */
export function scoreQuery(index, query) {
  const { postings, docNorm } = index;
  const terms = tokenize(query);
  const scores = new Map();
  for (const t of new Set(terms)) {
    const post = postings.get(t);
    if (!post) continue;
    const idf = Math.log(1 + (docNorm.length / (post.size + 1)));
    for (const [idx, weight] of post) {
      scores.set(idx, (scores.get(idx) ?? 0) + (weight / docNorm[idx]) * idf);
    }
  }
  return [...scores.entries()]
    .map(([index, score]) => ({ index, score }))
    .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score);
}

/** Top-k docs for a query: local ranking, optionally re-ordered by a Cohere rerank. */
export async function retrieve(docs, index, query, { topN = 5 } = {}) {
  const ranked = scoreQuery(index, query);
  if (!ranked.length) return [];

  const { cohereRerank } = await import('./ai.js');
  const reranked = await cohereRerank(query, ranked.slice(0, 10).map((r) => docText(docs[r.index])));
  if (reranked?.length) {
    const pool = ranked.slice(0, 10);
    pool.sort((a, b) => {
      const sa = reranked.find((r) => r.index === a.index)?.score ?? -1;
      const sb = reranked.find((r) => r.index === b.index)?.score ?? -1;
      return sb - sa;
    });
    return pool.slice(0, topN).map((r) => docs[r.index]);
  }
  return ranked.slice(0, topN).map((r) => docs[r.index]);
}

/** Compact document string for rerank/context. */
export function docText(doc) {
  const parts = [
    `Title: ${doc.title}`,
    `File: originals/${doc.key}`,
    doc.tags.length ? `Tags: ${doc.tags.join(', ')}` : '',
    doc.mood ? `Mood: ${doc.mood}` : '',
    doc.description ? `Caption: ${doc.description}` : '',
    doc.synopsis ? `Synopsis: ${doc.synopsis}` : '',
    doc.note ? `Note: ${doc.note}` : '',
  ];
  return parts.filter(Boolean).join('\n');
}

/** Fuzzy /piece lookup: exact key/title match, then substring over title/key/synopsis. */
export function findPiece(docs, query) {
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  if (!q) return null;
  let found = null;
  for (const d of docs) {
    if (d.key.toLowerCase() === q || d.title.toLowerCase() === q) return d;
  }
  for (const d of docs) {
    if (d.title.toLowerCase().includes(q)) { found = d; break; }
  }
  if (!found) {
    for (const d of docs) {
      if (d.key.toLowerCase().includes(q) || d.synopsis.toLowerCase().includes(q)
          || d.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)) { found = d; break; }
    }
  }
  return found;
}

export { existsSync };
```

```javascript
#!/usr/bin/env node
// bot/index.js — Discord bot for the Overkill archive (Suggestion 3: family can ask
// the archive anything). Slash commands over a RAG pipeline:
//
//   /ask     question -> local lexical retrieval (71 pieces: titles, captions, tags,
//            synopses, catalog notes) -> optional Cohere rerank -> NVIDIA answer with
//            per-piece citations. Uses ONLY the archive's own texts; refers to the
//            artist by his nickname "Overkill" (his real name is family info, exposed
//            only where it belongs — the memorial messages)
//   /search  instant local match list (no AI calls, works even if keys are exhausted)
//   /piece   caption + synopsis card for one piece
//   /random  a random piece of the archive
//   /catalog stats + links to the generated pages
//   /help    command list
//   /about   what the bot is, what it knows, privacy rule
//   /memorial-message  bot-owner only: write a fresh, never-repeated memorial for
//            Overkill from Living_Personality.md + captions/README.md; delivered
//            messages are tracked in .private/memorial_history.json (gitignored)
//
// Run: cd bot && npm install && node index.js   (or: npm start)
// Test: node index.js --selftest                (offline corpus/retrieval checks)
//       node index.js --selftest --live         (+ one real NVIDIA/Cohere call)
// Config: .private/config.json -> discord_bot.* (token, botowner, allowedIds,
//         allowed_guilds, allowed_channels, logging_channel; optional guildId
//         for legacy guild scoping)

import { existsSync, statSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { loadConfig, REPO_ROOT } from './config.js';
import { nvidiaConfigured, nvidiaChat } from './ai.js';
import { writeMemorial, captionsDigest, MAX_MEMORIAL_CHARS } from './memorial.js';
import {
  buildCorpus, buildIndex, retrieve, findPiece, docText, ghUrl, scoreQuery,
} from './rag.js';

const isSelfTest = process.argv.includes('--selftest');
const isLive = process.argv.includes('--live');

let config;
try {
  config = loadConfig();
} catch (err) {
  console.error(`[fatal] ${err.message}`);
  process.exit(2);
}

// Corpus + index are built once at boot; /ask and /search share them.
const docs = buildCorpus();
const index = buildIndex(docs);
const jpgCount = docs.filter((d) => d.key.startsWith('jpg/')).length;
const pdfCount = docs.filter((d) => d.key.startsWith('pdf/')).length;
const synCount = docs.filter((d) => d.synopsis).length;

function truncate(text, max) {
  return String(text ?? '').length > max ? `${String(text ?? '').slice(0, max - 1)}…` : String(text ?? '');
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- access + logging
let logChannel = null;

/** First access rule (if any) that blocks this interaction; null = allowed.
 *  Order of checks: user ids -> guild ids -> channel ids (all optional; an empty
 *  list means "no restriction" for that scope). */
function accessDenied(interaction) {
  if (config.allowedIds.length && !config.allowedIds.includes(interaction.user.id)) {
    return 'This bot is locked to family — your user id is not on the allowed list.';
  }
  if (config.allowedGuilds.length && !config.allowedGuilds.includes(interaction.guildId)) {
    return 'This bot is not enabled in this server.';
  }
  if (config.allowedChannels.length && !config.allowedChannels.includes(interaction.channelId)) {
    return 'This bot is not enabled in this channel — try the channel it lives in.';
  }
  return null;
}

/** Where a command ran, for log lines: "Server #channel" or "DM". */
function where(interaction) {
  return interaction.guild
    ? `${interaction.guild.name} #${interaction.channel?.name ?? interaction.channelId}`
    : 'DM';
}

/** Post a line to discord_bot.logging_channel (fire-and-forget); console keeps mirroring. */
function logToDiscord(text) {
  console.log(`[log] ${text}`);
  if (!logChannel) return;
  logChannel.send(`\`${new Date().toISOString()}\` ${text}`).catch((err) => {
    console.warn(`[log] logging channel send failed: ${err?.message ?? err}`);
  });
}

// Image extensions Discord renders inline in an embed; anything else (pdfs, …)
// stays a plain link in the embed.
const IMAGE_RE = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|bmp|webp)$/i;
const MAX_ATTACH_BYTES = 25 * 1024 * 1024; // Discord's per-file upload ceiling

/** Reply with the /piece card; jpgs/pngs/gifs/bmps/webps are attached and shown
 *  inside the embed (the repo is private, so Discord cannot proxy the GitHub
 *  links — the local file must travel with the message via attachment://). */
function pieceReply(interaction, doc) {
  const embed = pieceEmbed(doc);
  const files = [];
  if (IMAGE_RE.test(doc.key)) {
    const localPath = path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'originals', doc.key);
    try {
      if (existsSync(localPath)) {
        const size = statSync(localPath).size;
        if (size > 0 && size <= MAX_ATTACH_BYTES) {
          const name = path.basename(localPath);
          files.push({ attachment: localPath, name });
          embed.image = { url: `attachment://${encodeURIComponent(name)}` };
        } else {
          console.warn(`[image] ${doc.key}: ${size} bytes — skipping inline embed (upload limit ${MAX_ATTACH_BYTES})`);
        }
      } else {
        console.warn(`[image] ${doc.key}: missing locally, keeping link-only embed`);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(`[image] ${doc.key}: ${err?.message ?? err}`);
    }
  }
  return interaction.reply({ embeds: [embed], files });
}

function pieceEmbed(doc) {
  const embed = {
    author: { name: config.name },
    title: doc.title,
    url: doc.captionUrl,
    description: truncate(doc.description || doc.synopsis, 4096),
    fields: [],
    footer: { text: `originals/${doc.key} · caption + synopsis on the captions page` },
  };
  if (doc.mood) embed.fields.push({ name: 'Mood', value: truncate(doc.mood, 1024), inline: true });
  if (doc.tags.length) embed.fields.push({ name: 'Tags', value: truncate(doc.tags.join(', '), 1024), inline: true });
  if (doc.description && doc.synopsis) {
    embed.description = truncate(doc.description, 1024);
    embed.fields.push({ name: 'Synopsis', value: truncate(doc.synopsis, 1024) });
  }
  if (doc.note) embed.fields.push({ name: 'Note', value: truncate(doc.note, 1024) });
  embed.fields.push({
    name: 'Open',
    value: `[piece file](${doc.url}) · [captions page](${doc.captionUrl})`,
  });
  return embed;
}

const HELP_TEXT = [
  '**/ask** *question* — ask the archive anything; answers cite the pieces they draw on',
  '**/search** *query* — fast local match list (titles/tags/captions/synopses), no AI',
  '**/piece** *name* — full caption + synopsis card for one piece',
  '**/random** — a random piece from the archive',
  '**/catalog** — archive stats and links to the generated pages',
  '**/about** — what this bot knows and its privacy rule',
  '**/help** — this list',
  '**/memorial-message** — write a fresh memorial message (bot owner only)',
].join('\n');

const ANSWER_SYSTEM = [
  `You are "${config.name}'s Archive", a guide to a private memorial archive of the late `
  + 'artist known as "Overkill" (1969-2022) — Jeff to his family. The archive holds 50 drawings and 21 '
  + 'hand-made comic stories, described by AI captions and OCR read-throughs of the art itself.',
  '',
  'Answer the question using ONLY the piece notes below, and cite the pieces you draw on by '
  + 'their exact titles and file names. Refer to the artist by his nickname "Overkill" whenever possible; '
  + 'his first name is Jeff, and it is fine to use it when the question is personal or family-angled. '
  + 'Never invent names, dates, places, or backstories beyond what the notes say, and if the notes do not '
  + 'answer the question, say so plainly and name the pieces that come closest. Keep the answer to a few short paragraphs.',

function answerEmbed(question, answer, sources) {
  const embed = {
    author: { name: config.name },
    title: truncate(question, 256),
    description: truncate(answer, 4096),
    fields: [],

  };
  for (const doc of sources) {
    embed.fields.push({
      name: truncate(doc.title, 256),
      value: `[${doc.key}](${doc.url}) · [captions](${doc.captionUrl})`,
      inline: true,
    });
  }
  return embed;
}

function statsEmbed() {
  return {
    author: { name: config.name },
    title: 'Archive catalog',
    description: [
      `**${docs.length}** pieces — **${jpgCount}** drawings · **${pdfCount}** comics`,
      `**${synCount}** PDF pieces have full-story OCR synopses`,
      '',
      '[catalog](https://github.com/daniel-kill/Overkill/blob/main/catalog/index.md) · '

      + '[Living Personality](https://github.com/daniel-kill/Overkill/blob/main/Living_Personality.md)',

}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- self-test mode
async function runSelfTest() {
  console.log('Overkill bot — self-test');
  console.log(`  config: ${config.configFile}`);
  console.log(`  nvidia(${config.nvidia.model ?? '?'}): ${nvidiaConfigured() ? 'configured' : 'MISSING'}`);

  for (const [q, expected] of queries) {

    const top = hits[0];

    const pass = Boolean(top) && topLabel.includes(expected.toLowerCase());

  if (piece) ok += 1;

  // cover the whole corpus so /memorial-message has the full archive to draw on.

  console.log(`  memorial digest: ${digestCount} pieces distilled from captions/README.md (${docs.length} in corpus) ${digestCount >= docs.length ? 'OK' : 'FAIL'}`);
  if (digestCount >= docs.length) ok += 1;

  // Inline-image coverage: every image-type piece should resolve to a local file

  const imgDocs = docs.filter((d) => IMAGE_RE.test(d.key));

    .setDescription('Caption + synopsis card for one piece.')

  new SlashCommandBuilder().setName('random').setDescription('A random piece from the archive.'),
  new SlashCommandBuilder().setName('catalog').setDescription('Archive stats and links.'),
  new SlashCommandBuilder().setName('help').setDescription('Command list.'),
  new SlashCommandBuilder().setName('about').setDescription('What this bot knows, and its privacy rule.'),
  new SlashCommandBuilder().setName('memorial-message')

const client = new Client({ intents: [GatewayIntentBits.Guilds] });

  if (config.allowedIds.length) console.log(`[access] locked to user ids: ${config.allowedIds.join(', ')}`);
  if (config.allowedGuilds.length) console.log(`[access] locked to guilds: ${config.allowedGuilds.join(', ')}`);

    if (logChannel?.isTextBased?.()) {

    // allowed_guilds (instant), else the legacy guildId, else globally.

      ? config.allowedGuilds
      : (config.guildId ? [config.guildId] : []);
    let registered = 0;
    for (const guildId of targetGuilds) {
      const guild = await c.guilds.fetch(guildId).catch(() => null);
      if (guild) {

        registered += 1;
      } else {

    }
  } catch (err) {

    + `${config.allowedGuilds.length ? `guilds [${config.allowedGuilds.join(', ')}]` : 'all guilds'}, `
    + `${config.allowedChannels.length ? `channels [${config.allowedChannels.join(', ')}]` : 'all channels'}`);

client.on(Events.InteractionCreate, async (interaction) => {

    return interaction.reply({ content: deniedReason, ephemeral: true });
  }
  const opts = interaction.options.data
    .map((o) => `${o.name}=${typeof o.value === 'string' ? truncate(o.value, 80) : o.value}`)
    .join(' ');
  logToDiscord(`▶ /${name} by ${interaction.user.tag} (${interaction.user.id}) in ${where(interaction)}${opts ? ` — ${opts}` : ''}`);

    if (name === 'memorial-message') {

      }
```
