        logToDiscord(`⛔ denied /memorial-message by ${interaction.user.tag} (${interaction.user.id}) in ${where(interaction)} — not the bot owner`);
        return interaction.reply({ content: 'Only the bot owner can write memorial messages.', ephemeral: true });
      }
      await interaction.deferReply({ ephemeral: true }); // memorials are private, just for the family
      let result;
      try {
        result = await writeMemorial();
      } catch (err) {
        console.error(`[error] /memorial-message: ${err?.stack ?? err}`);
        logToDiscord(`⚠ /memorial-message error: ${err?.message ?? err}`);
        return interaction.editReply({ content: `The memorial machine hiccuped (${err?.message ?? err}). Try again in a moment.` });
      }
      if (result.error) {
        return interaction.editReply({ content: result.error });
      }
      logToDiscord(`📝 /memorial-message #${result.number} written for the family (${result.attempts} draft${result.attempts > 1 ? 's' : ''})`);
      return interaction.editReply({
        content: `**Memorial #${result.number}** — copy it from the box:\n\`\`\`\n${truncate(result.text, MAX_MEMORIAL_CHARS)}\n\`\`\``,
      });
    }
    if (name === 'help') {
      return interaction.reply({ embeds: [{ author: { name: config.name }, title: 'Commands', description: HELP_TEXT }] });
    }
    if (name === 'about') {
      return interaction.reply({ embeds: [{
        author: { name: config.name },
        title: `About ${config.name}`,
        description: `A private RAG bot over the Overkill archive: ${docs.length} pieces (${jpgCount} drawings, `
          + `${pdfCount} comics), described by AI captions and OCR read-throughs of the art itself.\n\n`
          + 'It only ever answers from the archive’s own texts — titles, captions, tags and synopses — and '
          + 'refers to the artist by his nickname "Overkill", as the family prefers.',
      }] });
    }
    if (name === 'catalog') {
      return interaction.reply({ embeds: [statsEmbed()] });
    }
    if (name === 'random') {
      const doc = docs[Math.floor(Math.random() * docs.length)];
      return pieceReply(interaction, doc);
    }
    if (name === 'piece') {
      const doc = findPiece(docs, interaction.options.getString('name', true));
      return doc
        ? pieceReply(interaction, doc)
        : interaction.reply({ content: 'No piece matches that name — try /search or a fragment like "critter".', ephemeral: true });
    }
    if (name === 'search') {
      const q = interaction.options.getString('query', true);
      const hits = scoreQuery(index, q).slice(0, 8);
      if (!hits.length) {
        return interaction.reply({ content: `Nothing in the archive matches “${q}”. Try broader words (e.g. "war", "beer", "critter").`, ephemeral: true });
      }
      const lines = hits.map((h, i) => {
        const d = docs[h.index];
        const tags = d.tags.length ? ` — ${d.tags.slice(0, 4).join(', ')}` : '';
        return `**${i + 1}.** **${d.title}**${tags} · [open](${d.url})`;
      });
      return interaction.reply({ embeds: [{
        author: { name: config.name },
        title: `Search: ${truncate(q, 256)}`,
        description: lines.join('\n'),
      }] });
    }
    if (name === 'ask') {
      await interaction.deferReply();
      const q = interaction.options.getString('question', true);
      if (!nvidiaConfigured()) {
        return interaction.editReply({ content: 'The NVIDIA key/model is not configured — /ask needs it. (Try /search, which is offline.)' });
      }
      const sources = await retrieve(docs, index, q, { topN: 5 });
      if (!sources.length) {
        return interaction.editReply({ content: 'Nothing in the archive matches that question. Try /search for close matches.' });
      }
      const answer = await nvidiaChat(ANSWER_SYSTEM, `Question: ${q}\n\nRelevant pieces:\n\n${sources.map(docText).join('\n\n---\n\n')}`, { maxTokens: 900 });
      return interaction.editReply({ embeds: [answerEmbed(q, answer, sources)] });
    }
    return interaction.reply({ content: `Unknown command: ${name}`, ephemeral: true });
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[error] /${name}: ${err?.stack ?? err}`);
    logToDiscord(`⚠ /${name} error: ${err?.message ?? err}`);
    const text = `Something went wrong (${err?.message ?? err}). Try /search instead.`;
    return interaction.deferred || interaction.replied
      ? interaction.editReply({ content: text }).catch(() => {})
      : interaction.reply({ content: text, ephemeral: true }).catch(() => {});
  }
});

client.login(config.token).catch((err) => {
  console.error(`[fatal] gateway login failed: ${err?.message ?? err}`);
  process.exit(2);
});


```

## `./Overkill/bot/memorial.js`

```javascript
// bot/memorial.js — /memorial-message internals.
// Writes a short memorial message for "Jeff" — the artist his family knew as Jeff,
// the world knew as Overkill — in the first person as the archive's caretaker (the
// bot owner), grounded ONLY in:
//   - Living_Personality.md  (full text — the distilled personality)
//   - captions/README.md     (distilled per piece: title, mood, tags, opening lines;
//                             the file is ~92 KB, too big to feed raw every call)
//   - real_info              (top-level .private/config.json family facts — real name,
//                             dates, ... read live so newly added fields just flow in)
// Every message delivered is recorded in .private/memorial_history.json (gitignored).
// Generation retries until the draft is not a duplicate of anything already delivered,
// and the most recent messages are shown to the model as "do not imitate", so each
// memorial is fresh and never repeated. Every message calls him Jeff and ends with a
// fixed family sign-off; the reply is ephemeral.

import { readFileSync, writeFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { loadConfig, REPO_ROOT } from './config.js';
import { nvidiaChat } from './ai.js';

const HISTORY_FILE = path.join(REPO_ROOT, '.private', 'memorial_history.json');

// Keep the message inside the reply's code block comfortably under Discord's
// 2000-char message limit (1900 + fence + lead-in line).
export const MAX_MEMORIAL_CHARS = 1900;

// Every memorial ends with this exact line, from the family (bot owner = Daniel).
const SIGN_OFF = '- Miss you everyday brother, Daniel';

const MEMORIAL_ATTEMPTS = 4; // tries before giving up on freshness for this invocation

export function loadMemorialHistory(file = HISTORY_FILE) {
  try {
    const parsed = JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8'));
    return Array.isArray(parsed?.messages) ? parsed.messages : [];
  } catch {
    return []; // missing or corrupt file = no history yet
  }
}

export function saveMemorialHistory(messages, file = HISTORY_FILE) {
  try {
    writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ messages }, null, 2) + '\n', 'utf8');
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error(`[memorial] history save failed: ${err?.message ?? err}`);
    return false;
  }
}

/** Normalize for duplicate detection: lowercase, whitespace collapsed. */
function normalize(text) {
  return String(text ?? '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

function truncate(s, n) {
  s = String(s ?? '');
  return s.length <= n ? s : `${s.slice(0, Math.max(0, n - 1))}…`;
}

/** Render real_info as a bullet list, skipping navigational URL fields. New keys the
 *  family adds to the section flow into the prompt automatically. */
function describeRealInfo(info) {
  if (!info || typeof info !== 'object') return '(none configured)';
  const skip = new Set(['obituary_URL', 'obituary_wayback_URL']);
  const entries = Object.entries(info).filter(([k]) => !skip.has(k));
  if (!entries.length) return '(none configured)';
  return entries.map(([k, v]) => `• ${k.replace(/_/g, ' ')} — ${v}`).join('\n');
}

/** Drop any sign-off/closing line the model added on its own — the fixed family
 *  sign-off is appended by the bot, so a double sign-off would look broken. */
function stripSignOff(text) {
  const lines = String(text ?? '').split('\n');
  while (lines.length && /^\s*[-–—]?\s*(miss(ing)? you|love,?|your brother|in loving memory|rest easy)/i.test(lines[lines.length - 1].trim())) {
    lines.pop();
  }
  return lines.join('\n').trim();
}

/** Distill captions/README.md into one compact line per piece. Each line carries
 *  the title, mood, tags and the start of the description/synopsis — enough for
 *  the model to feel the sweep of the archive without a 92 KB context. */
export function captionsDigest() {
  const md = readFileSync(path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'captions', 'README.md'), 'utf8');
  const lines = [];
  for (const section of md.split(/^## /m).slice(1)) {
    const title = section.split('\n')[0].trim();
    if (!title) continue;
    const mood = section.match(/-\s+\*\*Mood:\*\*\s*(.+)/)?.[1]?.trim() ?? '';
    const tags = section.match(/-\s+\*\*Tags:\*\*\s*(.+)/)?.[1]?.trim() ?? '';
    const body = section
      .split('\n')
      .filter((l) => !/^- \*\*|^<sub>|^<a id=/.test(l.trim())) // drop bullets, caption stamps, anchors
      .join(' ')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim()
      .slice(0, 240);
    lines.push(`• ${title}${mood ? ` | ${mood}` : ''}${tags ? ` | ${tags}` : ''} — ${body}`);
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}
/** The full prompt for one memorial. `used` lists already-delivered messages so the
 *  model deliberately avoids repeating their tone/structure/subject. */
export function buildMemorialPrompt(number, personality, digest, realInfo, used, retryNote) {
  const parts = [
    `Memorial message #${number} for Jeff, written by the archive's caretaker (the bot owner), for the family.`,
    '',
    '=== Living_Personality.md (the distilled portrait) ===',
    personality,
    '',
    '=== Piece digest, one line per piece, from captions/README.md ===',
    digest,
    '',
    '=== real_info (family facts — weave in what fits naturally) ===',
    describeRealInfo(realInfo),
    '',
    '=== Already delivered memorials — never repeat one; each new message must be fresh in tone, structure and subject ===',
    used.length ? used.map((m) => `#${m.number} (${m.date}): ${m.preview}…`).join('\n') : '(none — this is the first)',
  ];
  if (retryNote) parts.push('', retryNote);
  return parts.join('\n');
}

const MEMORIAL_SYSTEM = [
  'You are writing a short memorial message for Jeff — the late artist whose family knew him as Jeff and',
  'whose work was signed with the nickname "Overkill" (1969-2022). You write warm, personal memorial messages',
  'in the first person as the archive\'s caretaker (the bot owner), for the family and friends who will read them.',
  '',
  'Ground every sentence in what you are given: Living_Personality.md, the piece digest from captions/README.md,',
  'and the real_info block (family facts — real name, dates). Call him Jeff in this message: never the',
  'nickname "Overkill" — the only exception is quoting a piece title that itself contains "Overkill",',
  'such as "Overkill\'s Notebook Page" — and never the full legal name. Never invent facts beyond what the',
  'material says.',
  '',
  'Write something a real person would post for the family: sincere, specific, warm, with a little of his humor',
  'when it fits. Weave in at least two or three specific pieces from the digest by title. Plain paragraphs only —',
  'no markdown headers, no bullet lists, no code fences, no title line, and no sign-off or closing line (the',
  'message is signed automatically). Between 150 and 250 words.',
].join('\n');

/** Generate one fresh memorial message. Retries (up to MEMORIAL_ATTEMPTS) when the
 *  draft duplicates an already-delivered message; returns { text, number, attempts }
 *  on success or { error } when it could not find something fresh. Records the
 *  delivered message in the history file before returning it. */
export async function writeMemorial({ historyFile = HISTORY_FILE } = {}) {
  const history = loadMemorialHistory(historyFile);
  const number = history.length + 1;
  const realInfo = loadConfig().realInfo; // read live: newly added family facts flow in

  const personality = readFileSync(path.join(REPO_ROOT, 'Living_Personality.md'), 'utf8');
  const digest = captionsDigest();

  const recent = history.slice(-6);
  const used = recent.map((m, i) => ({
    number: number - recent.length + i,
    date: String(m.ts ?? '').slice(0, 10),
    preview: normalize(m.text).slice(0, 140),
  }));

  let last = '';
  for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MEMORIAL_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
    const retryNote = attempt > 1
      ? 'Note: your earlier drafts were rejected as too similar to the memorials already delivered. '
        + 'Pick a completely different angle this time — different opening line, different tone, different pieces to dwell on.'
      : '';
    const prompt = buildMemorialPrompt(number, personality, digest, realInfo, used, retryNote);
    const raw = await nvidiaChat(MEMORIAL_SYSTEM, prompt, { maxTokens: 500, temperature: 1.0 });
    const body = stripSignOff(String(raw ?? '').replace(/```/g, '').trim()) // never break the reply fence
      .replace(/\bJEFF\b/g, 'Jeff'); // models echo emphasis caps; keep it lowercase-natural
    if (!body) continue;

    // 2 chars for the blank line before the fixed family sign-off; the cap keeps the
    // whole fenced reply (editReply content) under Discord's 2000-char limit.
    const text = `${truncate(body, MAX_MEMORIAL_CHARS - SIGN_OFF.length - 2)}\n\n${SIGN_OFF}`;
    last = text;
    if (!history.some((m) => normalize(m.text) === normalize(text))) {
      history.push({ ts: new Date().toISOString(), by: 'botowner', text });
      saveMemorialHistory(history, historyFile);
      return { text, number, attempts: attempt };
    }
  }
  return last
    ? { error: `Couldn't write something fresh after ${MEMORIAL_ATTEMPTS} tries — the well is running dry. Try again a little later.` }
    : { error: 'The model returned an empty message. Try again in a moment.' };
}


```

## `./Overkill/bot/config.js`

```javascript
// bot/config.js — config loader for the Overkill Discord bot.
// Reads .private/config.json (gitignored); env vars win over the file, matching the
// ElyProjectX convention (DISCORD_TOKEN, BOT_GUILD_ID, BOT_ALLOWED_IDS, BOT_TTL_MIN).
//   discord_bot.name             — bot display name (informational)
//   discord_bot.token            — gateway token (required; env DISCORD_TOKEN overrides)
//   discord_bot.applicationId / publicKey — informational (webhook-verification fields)
//   discord_bot.inviteLink       — printed at boot
//   discord_bot.guildId          — optional: scope command registration to one guild (instant)
//   discord_bot.allowedIds       — optional: comma-separated Discord user ids allowed to use the bot
//   discord_bot.botowner       — optional: Discord user id with exclusive access to
//                                /memorial-message (env BOT_OWNER_ID overrides)
//   discord_bot.allowed_guilds   — optional: array of Discord guild ids the bot answers in
//                                  (empty list = anywhere; commands are registered in each
//                                  listed guild at boot). Env BOT_ALLOWED_GUILDS overrides,
//                                  comma-separated.
//   discord_bot.allowed_channels — optional: array of Discord channel ids the bot answers in
//                                  (empty list = anywhere). Env BOT_ALLOWED_CHANNELS overrides,
//                                  comma-separated.
//   discord_bot.logging_channel  — optional: Discord channel id that receives bot usage,
//                                  denial and error logs. Env BOT_LOGGING_CHANNEL overrides.
//   real_info (top level)        — optional: family facts used by /memorial-message
//                                  (real name, dates, ...). Read live at every call so
//                                  newly added fields appear without a restart.
//
// AI blocks (same fallbacks as the Python tools):
//   personality.* or captioning.*  -> NVIDIA chat completions for /ask answers
//   providers.cohere.apiKey        -> optional rerank stage (skipped silently when absent)

import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';

export const REPO_ROOT = path.resolve(path.dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), '..');

export function loadConfig() {
  const configFile = path.join(REPO_ROOT, '.private', 'config.json');
  let raw = {};
  try {
    raw = JSON.parse(readFileSync(configFile, 'utf8'));
  } catch (err) {
    throw new Error(`cannot read ${configFile}: ${err.message}`);
  }

  const bot = raw.discord_bot ?? {};
  const pick = (...keys) => {
    for (const k of keys) {
      const v = bot[k];
      if (v !== undefined && v !== null && String(v).trim() !== '') return v;
    }
    return '';
  };

  // Normalizes an id allowlist from either the file (array) or an env override
  // (comma-separated string) into a string array. Empty/absent = no restriction.
  const idList = (envValue, ...keys) => {
    const raw = envValue || pick(...keys);
    if (!raw) return [];
    return (Array.isArray(raw) ? raw : String(raw).split(','))
      .map((s) => String(s).trim())
      .filter(Boolean);
  };

  return {
    repoRoot: REPO_ROOT,
    configFile,
    token: process.env.DISCORD_TOKEN || pick('token', 'Token'),
    guildId: process.env.BOT_GUILD_ID || pick('guildId', 'GuildID') || null,
    allowedIds: (process.env.BOT_ALLOWED_IDS || pick('allowedIds') || '')
      .split(',').map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean),
    allowedGuilds: idList(process.env.BOT_ALLOWED_GUILDS, 'allowed_guilds', 'allowedGuilds'),
    allowedChannels: idList(process.env.BOT_ALLOWED_CHANNELS, 'allowed_channels', 'allowedChannels'),
    loggingChannel: process.env.BOT_LOGGING_CHANNEL || pick('logging_channel', 'loggingChannel') || null,
    botOwner: process.env.BOT_OWNER_ID || pick('botowner', 'botOwner') || null,
    realInfo: raw.real_info ?? null,
    inviteLink: pick('inviteLink', 'InviteLink'),
    name: pick('name') || 'Overkill',
    nvidia: raw.personality ?? raw.captioning ?? raw.providers?.nvidia ?? {},
    cohere: raw.providers?.cohere ?? {},
  };
}

```

## `./Overkill/tools/generate_captions.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
generate_captions.py — AI caption pass for the Overkill archive.

Reads the active captioning provider from .private/config.json (`captioning.*`
block), sends every uncaptioned piece to the configured vision model, and
writes results to captions/captions.json.

Files already present in captions.json are skipped, so re-running after
adding new drawings only captions the new ones.

Supported inputs:
  - originals/jpg/*.jpg (and .png/.jpeg/.webp if added later) — sent as-is
  - originals/pdf/*.pdf — if `pdftoppm` is installed, the FIRST page is
    rasterized and captioned (caption notes that it covers page 1 only)

Usage:
  python3 tools/generate_captions.py            # caption anything new
  python3 tools/generate_captions.py --force    # re-caption everything
  python3 tools/generate_captions.py --only X   # only files whose path contains X
  python3 tools/generate_captions.py --limit 3  # stop after 3 new captions (testing)
  python3 tools/generate_captions.py --dry-run  # list what WOULD run, no API calls

Never prints the API key. Keeps names out: the prompt forbids inventing
names/dates/backstories, and this script never reads the obituary URL.
"""

import argparse
import base64
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

from _common import anchor_for_key

REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
CONFIG_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, ".private", "config.json")
CAPTIONS_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "captions", "captions.json")
JPG_DIR = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "originals", "jpg")
PDF_DIR = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "originals", "pdf")

IMAGE_EXTENSIONS = (".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp")

# Should return ONLY a JSON object. Kept short and archival; no room for names.
CAPTION_PROMPT = (
    "You are an archivist captioning drawings for the private memorial archive of an artist "
    "known only as \"Overkill\" (1969-2022). Describe ONLY what is visibly in the image. "
    "Do NOT invent names, dates, places, or backstories that are not shown. "
    'Reply with exactly one JSON object (no markdown fences) with these keys: '
    '"title" (a short evocative title, 3-8 words), '
    '"description" (2-3 plain sentences: what is shown, the mood, the art style — media, '
    'hand/ink/pencil, paper, humor, level of detail), '
    '"tags" (an array of 4-8 lowercase descriptive tags), '
    '"mood" (one short phrase).'
)

MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3          # per file, counting fallback-model retries
RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS = 5   # sleep after 429/5xx before retrying
BETWEEN_FILES_SECONDS = 0.7
REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 150
PDF_PAGE1_RASTERIZE_DPI = 120


def load_config():
    """Load and validate the captioning block from .private/config.json."""
    if not os.path.exists(CONFIG_PATH):
        sys.exit(f"FATAL: config not found at {CONFIG_PATH}")
    with open(CONFIG_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        cfg = json.load(fh)
    cap = cfg.get("captioning") or {}
    for field in ("provider", "model", "apiKey", "base_url"):
        if not cap.get(field):
            sys.exit(f"FATAL: captioning.{field} missing/empty in {CONFIG_PATH}")
    return cap


def load_existing_captions():
    """Existing captions.json content as a dict; {} when missing or unusable."""
    if not os.path.exists(CAPTIONS_PATH):
        return {}
    with open(CAPTIONS_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        data = json.load(fh)
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def save_captions(captions):
    """Atomically write the captions dict to captions.json (tmp file + replace)."""
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(CAPTIONS_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    tmp = CAPTIONS_PATH + ".tmp." + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(captions, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
        fh.write("\n")
    os.replace(tmp, CAPTIONS_PATH)


def collect_inputs():
    """Return list of dicts: {key, abs_path, kind}. key is repo-relative, posix."""
    inputs = []
    if os.path.isdir(JPG_DIR):
        for name in sorted(os.listdir(JPG_DIR)):
            if name.lower().endswith(IMAGE_EXTENSIONS):
                inputs.append({
                    "key": "jpg/" + name,
                    "path": os.path.join(JPG_DIR, name),
                    "kind": "image",
                })
    if os.path.isdir(PDF_DIR):
        for name in sorted(os.listdir(PDF_DIR)):
            if name.lower().endswith(".pdf"):
                inputs.append({
                    "key": "pdf/" + name,
                    "path": os.path.join(PDF_DIR, name),
                    "kind": "pdf",
                })
    return inputs


def image_to_data_url(path):
    """Read an image file and return it as a base64 data URL."""
    ext = os.path.splitext(path)[1].lower().lstrip(".") or "jpeg"
    if ext == "jpg":
        ext = "jpeg"
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        b64 = base64.b64encode(fh.read()).decode("ascii")
    return f"data:image/{ext};base64,{b64}"


def rasterize_pdf_page1(pdf_path):
    """First page of a PDF -> PNG data URL, via pdftoppm (poppler-utils). None if unavailable."""
    if subprocess.run(["which", "pdftoppm"], capture_output=True, check=False).returncode != 0:
        return None
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
        stem = os.path.join(tmp, "page")
        result = subprocess.run(
            ["pdftoppm", "-png", "-r", str(PDF_PAGE1_RASTERIZE_DPI),
             "-f", "1", "-l", "1", pdf_path, stem],
            capture_output=True, check=False, timeout=120,
        )
        if result.returncode != 0:
            return None
        out = [f for f in sorted(os.listdir(tmp)) if f.lower().endswith(".png")]
        if not out:
            return None
        png = os.path.join(tmp, out[0])
        with open(png, "rb") as fh:
            b64 = base64.b64encode(fh.read()).decode("ascii")
        return "data:image/png;base64," + b64


def chat_completions(cap, model, data_url, prompt):
    """POST one chat-completions request; returns the model's reply text."""
    body = {
        "model": model,
        "max_tokens": 600,
        "temperature": 0.3,
        "messages": [{
            "role": "user",
            "content": [
                {"type": "text", "text": prompt},
                {"type": "image_url", "image_url": {"url": data_url}},
            ],
        }],
    }
    req = urllib.request.Request(cap["base_url"] + "/chat/completions",
                                 data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"), method="POST")
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    req.add_header("Accept", "application/json")
    req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + cap["apiKey"])
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT) as resp:
        payload = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    return payload["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]


def parse_caption(text):
    """Best-effort parse of the model reply into a dict with the 4 keys."""
    cleaned = text.strip()
    cleaned = re.sub(r"^```(?:json)?\s*|\s*```$", "", cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    start, end = cleaned.find("{"), cleaned.rfind("}")
    if start != -1 and end > start:
        try:
            obj = json.loads(cleaned[start:end + 1])
            if isinstance(obj, dict):
                out = {
                    "title": str(obj.get("title", "")).strip(),
                    "description": str(obj.get("description", "")).strip(),
                    "tags": [str(t).strip().lower() for t in obj.get("tags", []) if str(t).strip()],
                    "mood": str(obj.get("mood", "")).strip(),
                }
                if out["title"] or out["description"]:
                    return out
        except (ValueError, TypeError):
            pass
    # JSON shape failed — keep the raw text as the description, mark it.
    return {"title": "", "description": cleaned.strip(), "tags": [], "mood": ""}


def caption_file(cap, item):
    """Returns (caption_dict, model_used). Raises RuntimeError on hard failure."""
    if item["kind"] == "image":
        data_url = image_to_data_url(item["path"])
    elif item["kind"] == "pdf":
        data_url = rasterize_pdf_page1(item["path"])
        if data_url is None:
            raise RuntimeError("pdftoppm not available — install poppler-utils to caption PDFs")
    else:
        raise RuntimeError(f"unknown kind {item['kind']}")

    models = [cap["model"]]
    fallback = cap.get("fallback_model")
    if fallback and fallback != cap["model"]:
        models.append(fallback)

    last_err = None
    for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
        model = models[(attempt - 1) % len(models)]
        try:
            raw = chat_completions(cap, model, data_url, CAPTION_PROMPT)
            return parse_caption(raw), model
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
            code = err.code
            detail = err.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")[:200]
            if code in (429, 500, 502, 503):
                last_err = f"HTTP {code} (retryable): {detail}"
                print(f"      ...{code}; retry {attempt}/{MAX_ATTEMPTS} via {model}", flush=True)
                time.sleep(RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS)
                continue
            raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP {code}: {detail}") from err
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ConnectionError, OSError) as err:
            last_err = f"{type(err).__name__}: {err}"
            print(f"      ...{last_err}; retry {attempt}/{MAX_ATTEMPTS} via {model}", flush=True)
            time.sleep(RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS)
            continue
    raise RuntimeError(last_err or "exhausted retries")


def render_captions_md():
    """Write captions/README.md — the human-readable page the catalog links to."""
    captions = load_existing_captions()
    if not captions:
        return
    synopses = {}
    syn_path = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "captions", "synopses.json")
    if os.path.exists(syn_path):
        try:
            with open(syn_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
                syn_data = json.load(fh)
            synopses = syn_data if isinstance(syn_data, dict) else {}
        except (OSError, ValueError):
            synopses = {}
    lines = [
        "# Captions",
        "",
        "> Auto-generated by `tools/generate_captions.py` — do not edit by hand. "
        "Source of truth: `captions/captions.json`.",
        "",
        "AI-written titles, moods, tags and descriptions for the archive. "
        "The images themselves live in `originals/`; these texts describe only "
        "what is visibly in each piece. For the PDF pieces each entry also carries "
        "a **Synopsis** — a full-story read of the whole comic, OCR'd by "
        "`tools/generate_synopses.py` (`captions/synopses.json`).",
        "",
    ]
    for key in sorted(captions):
        e = captions[key]
        title = e.get("title") or key
        anchor = anchor_for_key(key)
        mood = e.get("mood", "")
        tags = ", ".join(e.get("tags", []))
        desc = e.get("description", "").strip()
        model = e.get("model", "")
        stamp = e.get("captioned_at", "")
        lines.append(f'<a id="{anchor}"></a>')
        lines.append(f"## {title}")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"- **File:** `originals/{key}`")
        if mood:
            lines.append(f"- **Mood:** {mood}")
        if tags:
            lines.append(f"- **Tags:** {tags}")
        lines.append("")
        if desc:
            lines.append(desc)
            lines.append("")
        synopsis = synopses.get(key, {}).get("synopsis", "").strip()
        if synopsis:
            lines.append(f"**Synopsis:** {synopsis}")
            lines.append("")
        if model or stamp:
            meta = " — ".join(x for x in (model, stamp) if x)
            lines.append(f"<sub>caption via {meta}</sub>")
            lines.append("")
    md_path = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "captions", "README.md")
    tmp = md_path + ".tmp." + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write("\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n")
    os.replace(tmp, md_path)


def main():
    """CLI entry point: caption pending pieces, then refresh rendered pages."""
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="AI caption pass for the Overkill archive")
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="re-caption everything (ignore existing)")
    ap.add_argument("--only", metavar="SUBSTR", help="only files whose path contains SUBSTR")
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="stop after N new captions (0 = no limit)")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="list what would run, make no API calls")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    cap = load_config()
    captions = {} if args.force else load_existing_captions()
    inputs = collect_inputs()

    pending = []
    for item in inputs:
        if args.only and args.only.lower() not in item["key"].lower():
            continue
        if item["key"] in captions and not args.force:
            continue
        pending.append(item)

    print(f"[config] provider={cap['provider']} model={cap['model']} "
          f"fallback={cap.get('fallback_model', '-')} base={cap['base_url']}")
    print(f"[scan]   {len(inputs)} pieces found; {len(pending)} pending; "
          f"{len(captions)} already in {os.path.relpath(CAPTIONS_PATH, REPO_ROOT)}")

    if args.dry_run:
        for item in pending:
            print("  would caption:", item["key"])
        return

    fresh, failed = 0, []
    for i, item in enumerate(pending, 1):
        print(f"[{i}/{len(pending)}] captioning {item['key']} ...", flush=True)
        try:
            parsed, model = caption_file(cap, item)
            parsed["model"] = model
            parsed["captioned_at"] = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
            if item["kind"] == "pdf":
                parsed["_note"] = "caption covers first page only"
            captions[item["key"]] = parsed
            save_captions(captions)
            fresh += 1
            title = parsed["title"] or item["key"]
            print(f"     ok: {title}", flush=True)
        # Deliberately broad: one bad piece must not abort the whole pass.
        except Exception as err:  # noqa: BLE001  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
            failed.append((item["key"], str(err)))
            print(f"     FAILED: {err}", flush=True)
        finally:
            if i < len(pending):
                time.sleep(BETWEEN_FILES_SECONDS)
        if args.limit and fresh >= args.limit:
            print(f"[limit] reached --limit {args.limit}; stopping.", flush=True)
            break

    print(f"[done]   {fresh} captioned; {len(failed)} failed.")
    if failed:
        print("[failed]")
        for key, err in failed:
            print(f"  - {key}: {err}")

    # Housekeeping AFTER the caption pass: refresh the rendered page and the
    # notes-preserving catalog. Never fail the pass over either of these.
    try:
        render_captions_md()
        from regenerate_catalog import rebuild  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
        rebuild()
        print("[finalize] updated captions/README.md and rebuilt catalog/index.md", flush=True)
    except Exception as err:  # noqa: BLE001  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
        print(f"[finalize] skipped (non-fatal): {err}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

## `./Overkill/tools/regenerate_catalog.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
regenerate_catalog.py — notes-preserving catalog generator for Overkill.

Rebuilds catalog/index.md from the files in originals/ WITHOUT destroying
hand-filled Notes (replaces the old bash loop that wiped them — see MEMORY §3).

Diff-friendly by design:
  - existing rows keep their ORDER, Size text and Notes verbatim;
  - brand-new files are appended, sorted, at the end of their format group;
  - fills a Caption column from captions/captions.json (title linked to the
    matching anchor in captions/README.md, which generate_captions.py renders).
  - Notes stays the LAST column, so old and new layouts parse identically.

Usage:
  python3 tools/regenerate_catalog.py             # rebuild in place
  python3 tools/regenerate_catalog.py --dry-run   # print the new table only
  python3 tools/regenerate_catalog.py --catalog /tmp/cat.md --originals /tmp/o
                                           --captions /tmp/captions.json
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import uuid

from _common import piece_name, human_size, anchor_for_key

REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
CATALOG_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "catalog", "index.md")
JPG_DIR = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "originals", "jpg")
PDF_DIR = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "originals", "pdf")
CAPTIONS_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "captions", "captions.json")

LINK_RE = re.compile(r"\]\(<\.\./originals/([^>]+)>\)")

HEADER_ROW = "| # | Piece | File | Format | Size | Caption | Notes |"
SEPARATOR = "|--:|-------|------|--------|-----:|-------|-------|"


def parse_old_table(text):
    """Split old catalog into (pre-table header text, ordered filenames, notes, sizes).

    Parses both 6-column (pre-caption) and 7-column catalog layouts; Notes is
    always the LAST cell, Caption (cols 5-6 in the 7-col layout) is ignored.
    """
    header, ordered, notes, sizes = [], [], {}, {}
    started = False
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if not started:
            if line.strip().startswith("|"):
                started = True
                continue  # old header row + separator
            header.append(line)
            continue
        if not line.strip().startswith("|"):
            continue
        cells = [c.strip() for c in line.strip().strip("|").split("|")]
        if len(cells) < 5:
            continue
        m = LINK_RE.search(cells[2])
        if not m:
            continue
        name = os.path.basename(m.group(1))  # hrefs include the format dir: jpg/Grunt.jpg
        ordered.append(name)
        notes[name] = cells[-1] if len(cells) > 5 else ""
        sizes[name] = cells[4] if len(cells) > 4 else ""
    return header, ordered, notes, sizes


def rebuild(catalog_path=None, jpg_dir=None, pdf_dir=None,
            captions_path=None, dry_run=False):
    """Regenerate the catalog. Returns the new markdown text. Raises on error."""
    catalog_path = catalog_path or CATALOG_PATH
    jpg_dir = jpg_dir or JPG_DIR
    pdf_dir = pdf_dir or PDF_DIR
    captions_path = captions_path or CAPTIONS_PATH

    captions = {}
    if os.path.exists(captions_path):
        with open(captions_path) as fh:
            captions = json.load(fh)
    if not isinstance(captions, dict):
        captions = {}

    header, ordered, old_notes, old_sizes = [], [], {}, {}
    if os.path.exists(catalog_path):
        with open(catalog_path) as fh:
            header, ordered, old_notes, old_sizes = parse_old_table(fh.read())

    # Group input files by format; preserve old order, append new sorted files.
    groups = []
    for fmt, directory in (("JPG", jpg_dir), ("PDF", pdf_dir)):
        if not os.path.isdir(directory):
            continue
        if fmt == "JPG":
            on_disk = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(directory)
                             if f.lower().endswith((".jpg", ".jpeg", ".png", ".webp")))
        else:
            on_disk = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(directory) if f.lower().endswith(".pdf"))
        seen = set()
        ordered_names = []
        for name in ordered:
            if name in seen:
                continue
            if "/" in name or os.path.dirname(name):
                # old rows store bare filenames; tolerate prefixed forms
                name = os.path.basename(name)
            if os.path.exists(os.path.join(directory, name)):
                ordered_names.append(name)
                seen.add(name)
        for name in on_disk:
            if name not in seen:
                ordered_names.append(name)
                seen.add(name)
        groups.append((fmt, directory, ordered_names))

    rows = []
    for fmt, directory, ordered_names in groups:
        rel_dir = "jpg" if fmt == "JPG" else "pdf"
        for name in ordered_names:
            path = os.path.join(directory, name)
            size = old_sizes.get(name) or human_size(os.path.getsize(path))
            notes = old_notes.get(name, "")
            key = f"{rel_dir}/{name}"
            cap_title = ""
            if key in captions:
                cap_title = captions[key].get("title") or ""
            if cap_title:
                cap = f"[{cap_title}](../captions/README.md#{anchor_for_key(key)})"
            else:
                cap = ""
            rows.append((piece_name(name), f"[{name}](<../originals/{rel_dir}/{name}>)",
                         fmt, size, cap, notes))

    lines = list(header)
    if lines and lines[-1].strip():
        lines.append("")
    lines.append(HEADER_ROW)
    lines.append(SEPARATOR)
    for i, (piece, link, fmt, size, cap, notes) in enumerate(rows, 1):
        lines.append(f"| {i} | {piece} | {link} | {fmt} | {size} | {cap} | {notes} |")
    new_text = "\n".join(lines).rstrip() + "\n"

    if not dry_run:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(catalog_path), exist_ok=True)
        tmp = catalog_path + ".tmp." + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
        with open(tmp, "w") as fh:
            fh.write(new_text)
        os.replace(tmp, catalog_path)
    return new_text


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Notes-preserving catalog generator for Overkill")
    ap.add_argument("--catalog", default=CATALOG_PATH, help="catalog file to rewrite")
    ap.add_argument("--originals", default=REPO_ROOT, help="repo root (originals/ lives here)")
    ap.add_argument("--captions", default=CAPTIONS_PATH, help="captions/captions.json path")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="print new table without writing")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    new_text = rebuild(
        catalog_path=args.catalog,
        jpg_dir=os.path.join(args.originals, "originals", "jpg"),
        pdf_dir=os.path.join(args.originals, "originals", "pdf"),
        captions_path=args.captions,
        dry_run=args.dry_run,
    )
    if args.dry_run:
        sys.stdout.write(new_text)
    else:
        n_rows = len(re.findall(r"^\| \d+ \|", new_text, flags=re.M))
        print(f"[done] catalog rewritten: {n_rows} rows -> {args.catalog}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()


```

## `./Overkill/tools/_common.py`

```python
"""Shared helpers for Overkill's tools scripts (caption pass + catalog regen)."""

import os
import re


def slugify(text):
    """GitHub-anchor-safe slug: lowercase, non-alnum runs become '-', trimmed."""
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", str(text).lower()).strip("-")


def anchor_for_key(key):
    """Stable anchor for a repo-relative piece key: 'jpg/X-Y.jpg' -> 'x-y'."""
    return slugify(os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(key))[0])


def piece_name(filename):
    """'Backbay-Bayoo-Critter_ALT.jpg' -> 'Backbay Bayoo Critter_ALT' (catalog style)."""
    return re.sub(r"-", " ", os.path.splitext(filename)[0]).strip()


def human_size(num_bytes):
    """'292K' / '1.3M' style sizes for brand-new catalog rows."""
    if num_bytes < 1024:
        return f"{num_bytes}B"
    if num_bytes < 1024 * 1024:
        return f"{num_bytes // 1024}K"
    return f"{num_bytes / (1024 * 1024):.1f}M"


def safe_cell(text):
    """Keep a markdown table cell intact (escape pipes, trim whitespace)."""
    return str(text).replace("|", "\\|").strip()

```

## `./Overkill/tools/generate_personality.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
generate_personality.py — AI "Living Personality" synthesis for the Overkill archive.

Reviews every caption in captions/captions.json — plus every full-story
synopsis in captions/synopses.json (the OCR read-throughs of the 21
multi-page pieces), when that file is present — with an AI model and builds
Living_Personality.md — a distilled, human-sounding portrait of the artist
Overkill (1969-2022) as revealed by his work: recurring themes, subjects,
moods, humor, media and style. The nickname-only privacy rule from the
caption pass applies here too: the prompt may use ONLY the archive texts
sent to it (captions + synopses), and this script never reads the obituary
URL (whose page contains real names).

Idempotent / change-triggered:
  - a SHA-256 over the normalized captions JSON and (when present) the
    synopses JSON is embedded in the output file as
    <!-- generated_from: <64-hex> -->
  - if the current digest already matches the one in Living_Personality.md the
    tool does NOTHING (no AI call, no write) — re-running the pipeline after
    unchanged captions.json and synopses.json is a no-op.
  - the digest is stored INSIDE the committed markdown file, so the
    "has it changed since last run?" state travels with the repo (no state
    file needed).

Config (.private/config.json, gitignored):
  - uses the `personality.*` block when present and complete
    (provider / model / apiKey / base_url), otherwise falls back to the
    `captioning.*` block, so a fresh clone with only the captioning config
    still works.

Usage:
  python3 tools/generate_personality.py             # rebuild only if changed
  python3 tools/generate_personality.py --force     # always rebuild
  python3 tools/generate_personality.py --dry-run   # say what WOULD happen, touch nothing
  python3 tools/generate_personality.py --model nvidia/llama-3.1-nemotron-70b-instruct
                                                    # override model for this run
  python3 tools/generate_personality.py --out /tmp/LP.md --captions /tmp/cap.json --synopses /tmp/syn.json

Never prints the API key.
"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re
import sys
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
CONFIG_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, ".private", "config.json")
CAPTIONS_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "captions", "captions.json")
SYNOPSES_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "captions", "synopses.json")
OUT_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "Living_Personality.md")

HASH_COMMENT_RE = re.compile(r"<!--\s*generated_from:\s*([0-9a-fA-F]{64})\s*-->")

MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3          # counting retryable HTTP errors
RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS = 5   # fallback sleep when the server gives no Retry-After
REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 300       # 90B-class synthesis can take ~4 min on the NVIDIA free tier
DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS = 2500

SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You are the resident writer for a private memorial archive of the late artist "
    'known only as "Overkill" (1969-2022). Your job is to distill the artist\'s '
    "personality from AI-written captions of his surviving work and from the "
    "full-story synopses of his multi-page comics (a reader's notes covering "
    "every page of each): what he drew, what recurred, what made him laugh, "
    "and what his hand did on paper.\n\n"
    "Hard rules:\n"
    "- Use ONLY the archive texts I send you (captions and synopses). Every "
    "claim you make must be traceable to them.\n"
    "- NEVER invent names, dates, places, backstories, or biographical facts. "
    "The only biographical markers allowed are the pseudonym 'Overkill' and the "
    "years 1969-2022.\n"
    "- Names that genuinely appear in the texts — e.g. characters in a story, "
    "such as 'Jack Mahogoff' or 'Papa Critter' — belong to the work and may be "
    "used as character names; never present them, or any other name, as a fact "
    "about the real artist.\n"
    "- Do not speculate about the artist's real life. Read the work as work.\n"
    "- Write warmly and plainly, in the register of a careful friend who knew "
    "the drawings and loved them. Dark humor can be named as dark humor. "
    "Affection is allowed; sentimentality and eulogizing are not.\n"
    "- Output ONLY the markdown body. No preamble, no closing note, no code "
    "fences, no title line (the page title is added by the script)."
)
SYNTHESIS_TEMPLATE = (
    "Below are {n} archive entries covering every piece in the collection "
    "({total} pieces): each has a title, mood, tags, and a description. "
    "{n_syn} of the multi-page pieces also carry a full-story synopsis — an "
    "AI read-through of the comic's own pages and words.\n\n"
    "Re-read the whole set, then write the 'Living Personality' document for "
    "Overkill as revealed by this work. Use these sections, in this order, "
    "with the exact markdown headings:\n\n"
    "## On paper\n"
    "A 2-3 paragraph distilled portrait: what kind of artist he was, the world "
    "his work builds, and what it says about the person holding the pen.\n\n"
    "## What he came back to\n"
    "The recurring subjects and characters (soldiers, critters, monsters,\n"
    "music, movies, etc.) as they show up across the captions and the\n"
    "synopses' story details, as a bulleted list. For each: name the subject,\n"
    "say how it shows up, and note roughly how many pieces touch it.\n\n"
    "## The humor\n"
    "A short section on the kind of humor in the work — dark, kind, absurd,\n"
    "punchline-driven — with concrete examples from the captions and synopses.\n\n"
    "## Moods he kept\n"
    "The moods that repeat across the pieces, in 3-5 bullets, each tied to\n"
    "actual captions.\n\n"
    "## The hand\n"
    "What the captions and synopses reveal about his materials and technique:\n"
    "pencil, ink, lined paper, handwriting, doodles, bold cartoon lines, drafts\n"
    "with revisions, speech bubbles, lettering, layout tricks.\n\n"
    "## The cast\n"
    "A short 'who keeps showing up' list of recurring characters and figures\n"
    "found in the captions and the synopses (named protagonists, critters,\n"
    "stock figures), as a bulleted list with one-line descriptions.\n\n"
    "## All in all\n"
    "A closing paragraph (no heading needed beyond this one) that says what the\n"
    "archive, taken whole, shows about the person who left these drawings.\n\n"
    "Length: {min_words}-{max_words} words total; do not exceed the upper end. "
    "Generalize from the evidence; "
    "quote or paraphrase caption and synopsis language when it earns its place. "
    "If a section has nothing to say from the archive texts, say so briefly "
    "instead of inventing.\n\n"
    "--- CORPUS START ---\n"
    "{corpus}\n"
    "--- CORPUS END ---"
)


def load_config():
    """Return {provider, model, apiKey, base_url} — personality.* else captioning.*."""
    if not os.path.exists(CONFIG_PATH):
        sys.exit(f"FATAL: config not found at {CONFIG_PATH}")
    with open(CONFIG_PATH, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        cfg = json.load(fh)

    chosen, label = None, None
    for key in ("personality", "captioning"):
        block = (cfg.get(key) or {})
        if all(block.get(f) for f in ("provider", "model", "apiKey", "base_url")):
            chosen, label = block, key
            break
    if chosen is None:
        sys.exit(
            "FATAL: neither personality.* nor captioning.* is complete in "
            f"{CONFIG_PATH} (need provider, model, apiKey, base_url)"
        )
    chosen = dict(chosen)
    chosen["_from"] = label
    return chosen


def load_captions(path):
    """Load captions JSON from path; exit fatally if missing, empty, or not a dict."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        sys.exit(f"FATAL: captions not found at {path}")
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        data = json.load(fh)
    if not isinstance(data, dict) or not data:
        sys.exit(f"FATAL: no captions in {path}")
    return data


def load_synopses(path):
    """Load synopses JSON; {} when missing or unusable. Synopses are an
    enrichment, not a requirement — a lone captions.json archive still works
    exactly as before."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        print(f"[scan]   synopses not found at {path} — continuing with captions only")
        return {}
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            data = json.load(fh)
    except (OSError, ValueError) as err:
        print(f"[scan]   synopses unreadable ({err}) — continuing with captions only")
        return {}
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        return {}
    # Keep only entries that actually carry a synopsis.
    return {k: v for k, v in data.items()
            if isinstance(v, dict) and str(v.get("synopsis") or "").strip()}


def archive_digest(captions, synopses=None):
    """Stable hash of the archive's CONTENT (captions + synopses; the JSON
    file's formatting/ordering does not count as a change)."""
    h = hashlib.sha256()
    for data in (captions, synopses):
        if not data:
            continue
        part = json.dumps(data, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False,
                          separators=(",", ":")).encode("utf-8")
        h.update(b"\x00")  # separator byte so concatenations cannot collide
        h.update(part)
    return h.hexdigest()

def existing_hash(path):
    """Digest embedded in a previous Living_Personality.md run, or None."""
    if not os.path.exists(path):
        return None
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            text = fh.read()
    except OSError:
        return None
    m = HASH_COMMENT_RE.search(text)
    return m.group(1).lower() if m else None


def build_corpus(captions, synopses=None):
    """Flatten captions (plus synopses, when present) into a compact text the
    synthesis model can chew on."""
    synopses = synopses or {}
    blocks = []
    for key in sorted(captions):
        e = captions[key]
        title = str(e.get("title") or key).strip()
        mood = str(e.get("mood") or "").strip()
        tags = ", ".join(str(t) for t in (e.get("tags") or []))
        desc = str(e.get("description") or "").strip()
        syn = str((synopses.get(key) or {}).get("synopsis") or "").strip()
        lines = [f"### {title}", f"file: {key}"]
        if mood:
            lines.append(f"mood: {mood}")
        if tags:
            lines.append(f"tags: {tags}")
        lines.append(f"description: {desc}")
        if syn:
            lines.append(f"synopsis: {syn}")
        blocks.append("\n".join(lines))
    return "\n\n".join(blocks)


def chat_completion(cfg, model, system, user, max_tokens):
    """Text-only OpenAI-style chat completion. Returns the assistant text."""
    body = {
        "model": model,
        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
        "temperature": 0.6,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": system},
            {"role": "user", "content": user},
        ],
    }
    req = urllib.request.Request(cfg["base_url"] + "/chat/completions",
                                 data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"), method="POST")
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    req.add_header("Accept", "application/json")
    req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + cfg["apiKey"])
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT) as resp:
        payload = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    content = payload["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    if not content or not str(content).strip():
        raise RuntimeError("empty model reply")
    return str(content).strip()

def strip_fences(text):
    """Best-effort removal of ``` markers / stray fences around the body."""
    cleaned = re.sub(r"^```(?:markdown|md)?\s*", "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    cleaned = re.sub(r"\s*```$", "", cleaned, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return cleaned.strip()


def synthesize(cfg, model, corpus, total, n_syn, max_tokens=DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS):
    """One synthesis pass with retries on retryable HTTP errors."""
    n_pieces = len(re.findall(r"(?m)^### ", corpus))
    user = SYNTHESIS_TEMPLATE.format(
        n=n_pieces,
        total=total,
        n_syn=n_syn,
        corpus=corpus,
        min_words=450,
        max_words=650,
    )
    last_err = None
    for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
        try:
            body = chat_completion(cfg, model, SYSTEM_PROMPT, user, max_tokens)
            return strip_fences(body)
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
            code = err.code
            detail = err.read().decode("utf-8", "replace")[:200]
            if code in (429, 500, 502, 503):
                last_err = f"HTTP {code} (retryable): {detail}"
                print(f"      ...{code}; retry {attempt}/{MAX_ATTEMPTS}", flush=True)
                retry_after = err.headers.get("Retry-After") if err.headers else None
                sleep_s = float(retry_after) if retry_after and retry_after.isdigit() \
                    else RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS
                time.sleep(sleep_s)
                continue
            raise RuntimeError(f"HTTP {code}: {detail}") from err
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ConnectionError, OSError) as err:
            last_err = f"{type(err).__name__}: {err}"
            print(f"      ...{last_err}; retry {attempt}/{MAX_ATTEMPTS}", flush=True)
            time.sleep(RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS)
            continue
    raise RuntimeError(last_err or "exhausted retries")


def write_personality(path, digest, body, n_captions, n_synopses=0):
    """Atomically write Living_Personality.md (header + hash pin + model body)."""
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    sources = (f"{n_captions} captions and {n_synopses} full-story synopses"
               if n_synopses else f"{n_captions} captions")
    text = (
        "# Living Personality\n\n"
        "> Auto-generated by `tools/generate_personality.py` — do not edit by hand.\n"
        "> Rebuilt only when `captions/captions.json` or `captions/synopses.json` changes. "
        f"Synthesized from {sources}.\n\n"
        f"<!-- generated_from: {digest} -->\n"
        f"<!-- generated_at: {stamp} -->\n\n"
        + body.rstrip()
        + "\n"
    )
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
    tmp = path + ".tmp." + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(text)
    os.replace(tmp, path)
    return stamp


def main():
    """CLI entry point: rebuild Living_Personality.md when the archive texts
    (captions.json and/or synopses.json) change."""
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="AI Living Personality synthesis for Overkill")
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true",
                    help="rebuild even if captions/synopses are unchanged")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true",
                    help="print what would happen; no API calls, no writes")
    ap.add_argument("--captions", default=CAPTIONS_PATH, help="path to captions.json")
    ap.add_argument("--synopses", default=SYNOPSES_PATH,
                    help="path to synopses.json (optional; captions-only when absent)")
    ap.add_argument("--out", default=OUT_PATH, help="output markdown path")
    ap.add_argument("--model", default=None, help="override the AI model for this run")
    ap.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS,
                    help=f"max reply tokens (default {DEFAULT_MAX_TOKENS})")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    cfg = load_config()
    model = args.model or cfg["model"]
    captions = load_captions(args.captions)
    synopses = load_synopses(args.synopses)
    digest = archive_digest(captions, synopses)
    corpus = build_corpus(captions, synopses)
    words = len(corpus.split())

    src = f"{len(captions)} captions"
    if synopses:
        src += f" + {len(synopses)} synopses"

    print(f"[config] provider={cfg['provider']} model={model} "
          f"base={cfg['base_url']} (from {cfg['_from']}.*)")
    print(f"[scan]   {src}; corpus ≈{words} words; "
          f"sha256={digest[:12]}…")
    print(f"[state]  {args.out}: {'absent' if not os.path.exists(args.out) else 'exists'}")

    current = existing_hash(args.out)
    changed = current != digest
    if not changed:
        print("[skip]   captions/synopses unchanged since last run — doing nothing.")
    if args.dry_run:
        print("[dry]    would " + ("regenerate" if changed or args.force else "do nothing")
              + f" (force={args.force})")
        return

    if current == digest and not args.force:
        return  # the "do nothing" contract — no AI call, no write

    print(f"[gen]    synthesizing Living Personality from {src} "
          f"via {model} ...", flush=True)
    body = synthesize(cfg, model, corpus, len(captions), len(synopses), args.max_tokens)
    stamp = write_personality(args.out, digest, body, len(captions), len(synopses))
    print(f"[done]   wrote {args.out} ({len(body.split())} words, {stamp})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

```

## `./Overkill/tools/generate_synopses.py`

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""
generate_synopses.py — full-story synopses for the 21 PDF pieces of the Overkill archive.

The vision caption pass can only see page 1 of a PDF (it rasterizes the first
page via pdftoppm and marks the caption "_note: caption covers first page
only"). This tool closes that gap in two stages:

  1. OCR — sends each PDF to Mistral's `mistral-ocr-latest` (the only Mistral
     model exposed on this account, verified 2026-09-01) as a base64 data URL
     and collects the markdown text of every page. If a PDF is too large for a
     single OCR call, it falls back to rasterizing every page with pdftoppm and
     OCRing each page image individually.
  2. Synthesis — hands the OCR text to the configured NVIDIA text model
     (personality.* block, falling back to captioning.*, same as
     generate_personality.py) and asks it for a plain-prose synopsis of the
     story: what happens, who appears (by the names the piece itself uses),
     the tone/humor. Same nickname-only rules as the caption pass: use ONLY
     the OCR text, never invent biographical facts. The piece titles in the
     filenames are the artist's own art titles, so they are safe to use.

Writes captions/synopses.json (keyed like captions.json, "pdf/<name>.pdf")
and re-renders captions/README.md so each PDF entry carries its Synopsis line.

Companion transcripts: if a hand-transcribed originals/pdf/<name>.md exists
next to <name>.pdf, its text is used to generate the synopsis instead of the
PDF — no Mistral OCR call is made, no ocr_model is recorded, and the entry is
marked "source": "md".

Config (.private/config.json, gitignored):
  - providers.mistral.apiKey        (required — OCR)
  - personality.* (provider/model/apiKey/base_url) or captioning.* (synthesis)

Idempotent: PDFs already present in captions/synopses.json are skipped unless
--force. Never prints the API key.

Usage:
  python3 tools/generate_synopses.py            # synopses for anything new
  python3 tools/generate_synopses.py --force    # regenerate everything
  python3 tools/generate_synopses.py --only X   # only PDFs whose name contains X
  python3 tools/generate_synopses.py --limit 2  # stop after 2 new synopses
  python3 tools/generate_synopses.py --dry-run  # list what WOULD run, no API calls
  python3 tools/generate_synopses.py --max-ocr-chars 80000   # OCR budget sent to the model (default 60000)
  python3 tools/generate_synopses.py --max-tokens 2000       # synthesis output cap (default 1800)
"""

import argparse
import base64
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
import uuid
from datetime import datetime, timezone

REPO_ROOT = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
CONFIG_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, ".private", "config.json")
PDF_DIR = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "originals", "pdf")
SYNOPSES_PATH = os.path.join(REPO_ROOT, "captions", "synopses.json")

OCR_ENDPOINT = "https://api.mistral.ai/v1/ocr"
OCR_MODEL = "mistral-ocr-latest"

MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3          # per request, counting retryable HTTP errors
RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS = 6   # sleep after 429/5xx before retrying
BETWEEN_FILES_SECONDS = 1.0
REQUEST_TIMEOUT = 300     # OCR and synthesis can both be slow on free tiers

RASTERIZE_DPI = 150       # only used for the per-page fallback path

SYNOPSIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT = (
    "You are an archivist writing reading notes for a private memorial archive of the late "
    'artist known only as "Overkill" (1969-2022). You are given optical character '
    "recognition (OCR) text of one of his multi-page drawn stories/comics. Write a "
    "synopsis of THIS piece: 3-6 short paragraphs describing what happens in the story, "
    "the characters that appear (by whatever names the piece itself uses), the tone and "
    "humor, and the style where the text shows it (panel captions, sound effects, "
    "lettering). Hard rules: use ONLY the OCR text given below; NEVER invent names, "
    "dates, places, or backstories; the only biographical markers allowed are the "
    "pseudonym 'Overkill' and the years 1969-2022; do not mention that the text came "
    "from OCR; reply in plain prose with no headings or bullet lists."
)


def load_config():
    if not os.path.exists(CONFIG_PATH):
        sys.exit(f"FATAL: config not found at {CONFIG_PATH}")
    with open(CONFIG_PATH) as fh:
        cfg = json.load(fh)

    mistral = (cfg.get("providers") or {}).get("mistral") or {}
    # The Mistral OCR key is only needed for PDFs that lack a companion .md
    # transcript; main() checks that lazily once the pending list is known.

    synth = cfg.get("personality") or cfg.get("captioning") or {}
    for field in ("model", "apiKey", "base_url"):
        if not synth.get(field):
            sys.exit(f"FATAL: synthesis block (personality.* or captioning.*) missing {field} "
                     f"in {CONFIG_PATH}")
    return mistral, synth


def load_existing_synopses():
    if not os.path.exists(SYNOPSES_PATH):
        return {}
    with open(SYNOPSES_PATH) as fh:
        data = json.load(fh)
    return data if isinstance(data, dict) else {}


def save_synopses(synopses):
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(SYNOPSES_PATH), exist_ok=True)
    tmp = SYNOPSES_PATH + ".tmp." + uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]
    with open(tmp, "w") as fh:
        json.dump(synopses, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)
        fh.write("\n")
    os.replace(tmp, SYNOPSES_PATH)


def find_companion_md(pdf_path):
    """Path of a hand-transcribed <stem>.md sitting next to <stem>.pdf in the
    same directory (stem match is case-insensitive), or None."""
    directory = os.path.dirname(pdf_path)
    stem = os.path.splitext(os.path.basename(pdf_path))[0]
    if not os.path.isdir(directory):
        return None
    for name in os.listdir(directory):
        if name.lower().endswith(".md") and \
                os.path.splitext(name)[0].lower() == stem.lower():
            return os.path.join(directory, name)
    return None


def collect_pdfs():
    out = []
    if os.path.isdir(PDF_DIR):
        for name in sorted(os.listdir(PDF_DIR)):
            if name.lower().endswith(".pdf"):
                path = os.path.join(PDF_DIR, name)
                item = {"key": "pdf/" + name, "path": path}
                md_path = find_companion_md(path)
                if md_path:
                    item["md_path"] = md_path
                out.append(item)
    return out


def pdf_to_data_url(path):
    with open(path, "rb") as fh:
        b64 = base64.b64encode(fh.read()).decode("ascii")
    return "data:application/pdf;base64," + b64


def rasterize_all_pages(pdf_path, tmpdir):
    """Every page of a PDF -> list of PNG data URLs via pdftoppm. Empty list if unusable."""
    if subprocess.run(["which", "pdftoppm"], capture_output=True).returncode != 0:
        return []
    stem = os.path.join(tmpdir, "page")
    result = subprocess.run(
        ["pdftoppm", "-png", "-r", str(RASTERIZE_DPI), pdf_path, stem],
        capture_output=True, check=False, timeout=300,
    )
    if result.returncode != 0:
        return []
    pages = []
    for fname in sorted(os.listdir(tmpdir)):
        if not fname.lower().endswith(".png"):
            continue
        with open(os.path.join(tmpdir, fname), "rb") as fh:
            b64 = base64.b64encode(fh.read()).decode("ascii")
        pages.append("data:image/png;base64," + b64)
    return pages


def _post_json(url, body, headers, timeout):
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"), method="POST")
    for k, v in headers.items():
        req.add_header(k, v)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
        return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))


def ocr_pdf(mistral_key, item):
    """OCR a whole PDF -> (markdown_text, page_count, used_fallback)."""
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "Authorization": "Bearer " + mistral_key,
    }

    def ocr_document(data_url):
        body = {"model": OCR_MODEL,
                "document": {"type": "document_url", "document_url": data_url}}
        return _post_json(OCR_ENDPOINT, body, headers, REQUEST_TIMEOUT)

    # Path 1: the whole PDF as one base64 data URL.
    try:
        data = ocr_document(pdf_to_data_url(item["path"]))
        fallback = False
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
        detail = err.read().decode("utf-8", "replace").lower()
        if err.code in (413, 400, 422) and "too large" in detail:
            data, fallback = None, True
        else:
            raise

    if data is None:
        # Path 2: per-page rasterization, one OCR call per page image.
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            pages = rasterize_all_pages(item["path"], tmp)
            if not pages:
                raise RuntimeError("PDF too large for single OCR call and pdftoppm "
                                   "is unavailable — install poppler-utils")
            chunks, retried = [], False
            for i, img in enumerate(pages, 1):
                try:
                    data = ocr_document(img)
                except urllib.error.HTTPError as err:
                    if err.code in (429, 500, 502, 503) and not retried:
                        retried = True
                        time.sleep(RETRY_AFTER_SECONDS)
                        data = ocr_document(img)
                    else:
                        raise
                pages_md = [p.get("markdown", "") for p in data.get("pages", [])]
                chunks.append(f"\n\n--- page {i} ---\n\n" + "\n\n".join(pages_md))
            return "\n".join(chunks), len(pages), True

    pages = data.get("pages", [])
    n_pages = len(pages)
    if not n_pages:
        raise RuntimeError("OCR returned no pages")
    markdown = "\n\n".join(p.get("markdown", "") for p in pages)
    return markdown, n_pages, fallback


def clean_ocr(text):
    """Drop markdown image references (![...](...)) and bare img-N file tokens that
    Mistral's OCR markdown emits — they refer to extracted page images, not story text."""
    text = re.sub(r"!\[[^\]]*\]\([^)]*\)", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\bimg-\d+\.jpe?g\b", "", text, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return re.sub(r"\n{3,}", "\n\n", text).strip()


def synthesize(synth, item, ocr_text, max_tokens):
    """NVIDIA chat-completions call (text only). Returns the synopsis body."""
    body = {
        "model": synth["model"],
        "max_tokens": max_tokens,
        "temperature": 0.4,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": SYNOPSIS_SYSTEM_PROMPT},
            {"role": "user",
             "content": f"Piece file: {item['key']}\n\nOCR text of the piece:\n\n{ocr_text}"},
        ],
    }
    req = urllib.request.Request(synth["base_url"] + "/chat/completions",
                                 data=json.dumps(body).encode("utf-8"), method="POST")
    req.add_header("Content-Type", "application/json")
    req.add_header("Accept", "application/json")
    req.add_header("Authorization", "Bearer " + synth["apiKey"])
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=REQUEST_TIMEOUT) as resp:
        payload = json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
    content = payload["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
    content = re.sub(r"^```(?:markdown|text)?\s*|\s*```$", "", content, flags=re.IGNORECASE)
    return content.strip()


def read_companion_md(md_path):
    """Read a curated transcript .md -> (text, page_count). page_count is the
    highest "## Page N" marker found (count of such sections if no numbers
    parse), or None when the file has no page headings at all."""
    with open(md_path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        text = fh.read()
    headings = re.findall(r"^##\s+(.*)$", text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    if not headings:
        return text, None
    nums = [int(m.group(1)) for h in headings
            if (m := re.search(r"(\d+)\s*$", h.strip()))]
    return text, (max(nums) if nums else len(headings))


def generate_one(mistral_key, synth, item, max_ocr_chars, max_tokens):
    if item.get("md_path"):
        # Curated transcript takes priority — no OCR call at all.
        ocr_text, n_pages = read_companion_md(item["md_path"])
        fallback = False
        source = "md"
    else:
        ocr_text, n_pages, fallback = ocr_pdf(mistral_key, item)
        source = "ocr"
    ocr_text = clean_ocr(ocr_text)
    ocr_chars = len(ocr_text)
    truncated = False
    if ocr_chars > max_ocr_chars:
        ocr_text = ocr_text[:max_ocr_chars]
        truncated = True
    synopsis = synthesize(synth, item, ocr_text, max_tokens)
    stamp = datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
    entry = {
        "synopsis": synopsis,
        "ocr_pages": n_pages,
        "ocr_chars": ocr_chars,
        "ocr_truncated": truncated,
        "model": synth["model"],
        "generated_at": stamp,
    }
    if source == "md":
        entry["source"] = "md"
    else:
        entry["ocr_model"] = OCR_MODEL
    if fallback:
        entry["ocr_fallback"] = "rasterized-per-page"
    return entry


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Full-story synopses for the Overkill PDF pieces")
    ap.add_argument("--force", action="store_true", help="regenerate everything")
    ap.add_argument("--only", metavar="SUBSTR", help="only PDFs whose name contains SUBSTR")
    ap.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="stop after N new synopses (0 = no limit)")
    ap.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="list what would run, no API calls")
    ap.add_argument("--max-ocr-chars", type=int, default=60000,
                    help="OCR characters sent to the synthesis model per piece")
    ap.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=1800,
                    help="max tokens for the synopsis reply")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    mistral, synth = load_config()
    synopses = {} if args.force else load_existing_synopses()

    pending = []
    for item in collect_pdfs():
        if args.only and args.only.lower() not in item["key"].lower():
            continue
        if item["key"] in synopses and not args.force:
            continue
        pending.append(item)

    if any(not item.get("md_path") for item in pending) and not mistral.get("apiKey"):
        sys.exit("FATAL: providers.mistral.apiKey missing/empty in .private/config.json "
                 "(needed to OCR PDFs; PDFs with a companion .md transcript skip OCR)")

    n_md = sum(1 for item in pending if item.get("md_path"))
    print(f"[config] synth model={synth['model']} base={synth['base_url']}")
    print(f"[scan]   {len(pending)} PDFs pending; {len(synopses)} already in "
          f"{os.path.relpath(SYNOPSES_PATH, REPO_ROOT)}")
    if n_md:
        print(f"[scan]   {n_md} of those have companion .md transcripts "
              f"(used instead of OCR)")

    if args.dry_run:
        for item in pending:
            src = "md" if item.get("md_path") else "ocr"
            print(f"  would synopsize ({src}):", item["key"])
        return

    fresh, failed = 0, []
    for i, item in enumerate(pending, 1):
        src = "md" if item.get("md_path") else "ocr"
        print(f"[{i}/{len(pending)}] synopsizing {item['key']} ({src}) ...", flush=True)
        try:
            synopses[item["key"]] = generate_one(
                mistral["apiKey"], synth, item, args.max_ocr_chars, args.max_tokens)
            save_synopses(synopses)
            fresh += 1
            print(f"     ok: {len(synopses[item['key']]['synopsis'])} chars, "
                  f"{'md' if item.get('md_path') else 'ocr'}="
                  f"{synopses[item['key']]['ocr_pages']} pages", flush=True)
        except Exception as err:  # noqa: BLE001 — keep the pass running
            import traceback
            failed.append((item["key"], str(err)))
            print(f"     FAILED: {err}\n{traceback.format_exc()}", flush=True)
        finally:
            if i < len(pending):
                time.sleep(BETWEEN_FILES_SECONDS)
        if args.limit and fresh >= args.limit:
            print(f"[limit] reached --limit {args.limit}; stopping.", flush=True)
            break

    print(f"[done]   {fresh} synopsized; {len(failed)} failed.")
    for key, err in failed:
        print(f"[failed] {key}: {err}")

    # Housekeeping AFTER the pass: refresh the captions page so PDF entries show
    # their Synopsis lines. Never fail the pass over this.
    try:
        from generate_captions import render_captions_md
        render_captions_md()
        print("[finalize] re-rendered captions/README.md with synopses", flush=True)
    except Exception as err:  # noqa: BLE001
        print(f"[finalize] skipped (non-fatal): {err}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
